story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 안녕

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 다시 바빠지기 전에 확인하고 싶었어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 오늘 기분이 어때, 정말로?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 아직 뻣뻣하고, 내가 원하는 때에 일어날 수 없는 게 짜증나.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 하지만 당신은 치유되고 있고, 그것이 중요합니다, 비록 느리게 느껴지더라도

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 너도 모든 것에 대해 스스로를 탓하는 걸 멈춰야 해.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 당신은 다치기로 선택하지 않았고, 도움을 필요로 하는 것이 부담이 아닙니다.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 나는 노력하고 있어

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 하루 종일 침대에 누워 있으면 유용하다고 느끼기 정말 힘들어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 안녕

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 알겠어

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 그런데, 새 전화기는 지금까지 어떤 느낌이야?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 모든 것이 이전 것에서 제대로 전송된 것처럼 보이나요?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 응, 놀랍게도

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 빠르고 모든 것이 제자리에 있는 것 같아요.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 나는 설정을 거의 다시 할 필요가 없었어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 좋아

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 그걸 나에게 팔던 남자가 계속해서 이게 튼튼한 모델이라고 주장했어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 다시 한 번 나를 위해 가져다줘서 고마워요.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 당신이 그렇게 할 필요는 없었다는 걸 알지만, 지금 정말 도움이 됩니다.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 내가 너를 깨웠어, 아니면 너는 이미 깨어나고 있었던 거야?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 물론 도움이 돼요

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 당신도 좋은 것들을 받을 자격이 있어요, 비록 항상 그렇게 믿지 않더라도.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …알겠어

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 사실, 새 전화기 위해 아직 필요한 게 하나 있어요.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 깨끗한 연락처 사진을 요구하고 있는데, 내가 가진 것은 오래된 거야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 오

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 내 연락처에 새로운 사진이 필요해?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 알겠어, 잠깐만 기다려줘

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 2분 후

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 나는 이미 깨어 있었어, 걱정하지 마세요.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 조금, 하지만 괜찮아, 네가 문자해서 기뻐.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 거기

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 그게 끔찍해 보인다면, 불평할 수 없어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 완벽해요

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Korean.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 쉬어보세요

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 나중에 먹을 것을 가져다 줄게 그리고 다시 확인할게

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 감사합니다, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 좋아

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 나는 네가 지금 그 화면을 바라보는 것 외에는 별로 할 수 없다는 걸 계속 잊고 있어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 죄송합니다

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 그냥 네가 사라지지 않았는지 확인 중이야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around
{{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}}가 내 프로필 사진이 필요하다고 했지, 맞아?

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
You always have something to say

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 사실 너를 위한 새로운 연락처 사진이 필요했어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 너 깨어 있어, 아니면 자고 있는 척하는 거야? 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you
You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 너는 슬픈 화분과 같은 에너지를 가지고 있어 🌱

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 아마도 내가 속이고 있었을지도. 누가 묻느냐에 따라 다르지

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 나는 이야기를 올리고 새 게시물을 올릴 준비가 되었어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 나는 네가 아는 가장 귀여운 소녀야 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: 하지만 적어도 그녀의 문자에는 답장해야 해.

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: 너는 나에게 그것을 증명할 필요 없어

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 음, 나는 괜찮아, 적어도 죽지는 않았어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I understand but it’s not your fault
Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 쉬고 회복해, 너의 생존이 나에게는 나머지보다 더 중요해.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 내가 답장이 느린 이유 중 하나는 새 전화기 때문이야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 그런데 프로필 사진을 보내줄 수 있어?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}}가 네 예전 사진이 사고로 망가졌다고 했어

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
Way smoother than the old one
It glitches a bit sometimes though

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 하지만 나는 그것을 빨리 길들일 거야 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
I didn’t mean to worry you
It’s just hard not to think sometimes
It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 최근에 너무 힘들었어, 얼마나 오랫동안 침대에 갇혀 있었는지 모르겠고, 모두와 함께하는 좋은 것들을 놓치고 있어, 특히 너와 함께하는 것.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 누군가 너를 만졌다면, 이름을 알고 싶어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 그녀는 기본적으로 캠퍼스에서 가장 예쁜 소녀야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 하지만 나중에 기억나는 게 있으면 나한테 말해줘.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}}이 네 새 번호를 줬어. 요즘 어떻게 지내?

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 이전에 이상한 오류가 있었지만 심각한 건 아니야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 사진을 보내줘, 그래야 네 프로필을 제대로 설정할 수 있어.
내 연락처 상태를 이미 업그레이드하고 있어요.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play
Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 하지만 간식에 대해 내가 할 수 있는 걸 보겠다.
{{name:evelyn}}이 곧 너에게 음식을 가져다 줄 거야

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 그녀가 들어오기 전에 창문을 열어야 해.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 너의 방은 아마 병원 냄새와 게이머 땀 냄새가 섞인 것 같아 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 바이오 해저드 팀이 도착하기 전에 환기시켜라.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 다시 그런 식으로 나를 무시하지 마 😅

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
My head feels kind of loud
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 내 머리가 좀 시끄러운 것 같아

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 너의 생각이 느려지지 않을 것 같아?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 나는 일할 때 너를 생각하고 있었어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 그냥 한 명의 극적인 고객이었지만 나는 살아남았어 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 내일 발표가 있는데 계속 머릿속에서 반복하고 있어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 나는 정말 무겁게 굴려고 하는 게 아니야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 나는 그냥 일이 진행되기를 원해, 알지?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 아침에는 일하고, 그다음엔 발표하고 아마 공부를 더 할 것 같아

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 하지만 지금은 내 일정보다 너가 더 중요해 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
You don’t have to act strong with me
You already are in my eyes ❤️
And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 침대에 갇혀 있다면 그건 네 잘못이 아니야.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course
The timing is bad but we can’t control that
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 타이밍이 안 좋지만 우리는 그것을 제어할 수 없어.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Why do you think I’m the best girlfriend in the world?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 왜 내가 세상에서 최고의 여자친구라고 생각해?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I ate and crashed for a bit
Sooo are you going to sleep soon?
My brain doesn’t want to stop

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You really suffer so much because of me

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Can I get a picture of the girl ruining my sleep before she leaves for uni?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 대학 가기 전에 내 잠을 망치는 소녀의 사진을 받을 수 있을까?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now behave while I'm in class 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 하지만 아마 당신 집에서 일어난 일과 조금 관련이 있을지도 몰라요 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You've been waiting all morning to see this body in action

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Are you ready for your punishment?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was worried a second ago. Now I'm struggling to find my words.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I just got out of the shower

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page

Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Go win the next round then

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: How did the first ones go?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 함께 해결해 나가는 게 맞는 것 같아

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want it to stay like that with you

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 이제 자려고 할 때 너무 많이 생각하게 만들고 있어.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 당신은 믿을 수 없을 만큼 멋져요.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And way too proud of yourself

나는 오늘 밤 매우 빠르게 배우고 있어요.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 너와 함께 이걸 더 많이 원하기 때문이야.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 그날 대화 나눴던 게 정말 기뻐요.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 서로에게 그렇게 솔직할 때 정말 기분이 좋다.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 우리가 서로 더 명확해져서 이제 훨씬 기분이 좋아요.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 그리고 나는 우리가 점점 더 마음을 열기를 정말 기다릴 수 없어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 나는 아직 그걸 준비할 준비가 안 된 것 같아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
Told you I had decent taste
Don’t sound so pleased with yourself

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
New skill available: Live Transcription
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 새로운 기술 사용 가능: 실시간 전사

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 관심 인물을 모니터링하여 다른 곳에서 일어나는 대화를 포착해

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
How does your leg feel this morning?
Strange without the cast
I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 움직일 때 그 무게를 느낄 것 같아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
Then we're doing the short walk today
There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 입구 근처에 벤치가 있어. 원할 때 거기서 쉴 수 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
Yes. Very advanced date planning
I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 저녁은 내가 준비할게. 너는 벤치를 맡아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
A balanced relationship 😌
Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 하지만 아침을 먼저 먹어야 해. 빈속으로 나가고 싶지 않아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
What are you making?
Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
You remembered dessert. Excellent start
You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 그게 뭔지 알기 위해서는 기다려야 해

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 좋아. 너도 기다려야 할 게 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 벌써 날씨를 세 번이나 확인한 게 이상해?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 어제 네가 고른 걸 입고 있어 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 그리고 네가 고른 다른 것도 샀어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 쇼핑 리스트를 끝내. 제대로 먹고 싶어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
Three it is
Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 출발할 때 문자해줘. 나보다 먼저 가려고 서두르지 마

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
See you this afternoon, love ❤️
Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 그건 좀 다르지. 허리케인이 올 거라고 예상하는 거야?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 우리 공원 데이트가 비 맞는 건 싫어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 그걸 핑계로 나한테 아주 가까이 서고 싶겠지

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 좋은 날씨일 때도 그렇게 하려고 했어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 특히 네가 그 사진을 봤으면 좋겠다고 인정했던 부분

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 그걸 소리 내서 말했단 게 아직도 믿기지 않아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 하지만 말하기 시작하니까 멈추기가 이상하게 느껴졌어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 보통은 너무 현실적인 건 농담으로 넘기거든

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
And you didn’t push me either

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 그게 더 안 좋았던 것 같아.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
I was trying not to overdo it
I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 너가 나보다 더 잘 처리한 것 같아.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly
Or were you just being polite?
You really didn’t have to say that
I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
Before I ask something even more dangerous
And… don’t overthink this too much either

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 공원에서 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 이렇게?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 이제 우리 실제 공원 데이트 사진이 생겼어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 지난 일요일 미리보기보다 나아

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 훨씬 나아. 너도 이 사진에 나와 함께 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내 어깨는 거의 안 되는 거야

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내게는 중요해

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 거기. 이제 그 어깨를 다시 원해.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 너희는 벤치에서 잠시 함께 시간을 보내. {{name:lena}}가 너에게 기대어 이야기하고, 짧은 길을 함께 가. 떠나기 전에 입구 근처에서 아이스크림을 나눠 먹어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 돌아갈 준비 됐어?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 입구에 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 응. 오늘 내 다리는 충분히 걸은 것 같아.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그럼 너의 집으로 바로 가자. 저녁 전에 쉴 수 있어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그리고 나랑 같이 있어줄 수 있어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그건 이미 계획의 일부였어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 너희는 함께 공원을 떠나 너의 집으로 바로 간다. 안에 들어가자마자 {{name:lena}}가 소파 옆에 가방을 두고 너의 다리를 쿠션에 올려주도록 도와줘.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 나아?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 훨씬 나아. 긴 루프는 건너뛰길 잘했어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 우리 벤치가 좋았어. 특히 그 개가 다음 벤치를 훔치려고 하기 전까지.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그는 자신이 원하는 걸 정확히 알고 있었어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 나도 그랬어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그런데 작은 아이스크림 가게가 열려 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}}가 너 옆에 앉아 손을 너의 손 위에 올려.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내가 가장 좋아하는 부분은 네가 먹으려고 내 손을 놓지 않으려던 거야.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 나는 완벽하게 잘 해냈어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 너가 내 엄지에 아이스크림을 묻혔어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 사소한 기술적 문제야.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내가 요리를 시작하기 전에 시간이 좀 있어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 좋아. 잠시 나랑 여기 있어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그건 반박하지 않을게.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 너희는 소파에서 오후의 나머지를 함께 보낸다. {{name:lena}}는 어제 네가 고른 옷을 그대로 입고, 너는 부엌으로 가기 전에 다리를 쉬게 해.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내가 나타나기 전에 그걸 먼저 찾았어?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 유용한 정보를 모으고 있어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 왼쪽을 봐

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
{{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}}가 핸드폰을 치우고 너에게 다가와. 그녀가 너에게 키스한 후, 손을 너의 손에 쥐어줘. 너는 공원을 지나 짧은 길을 가고, 다리가 피곤해지면 벤치에 멈춰.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 조금 후

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 더 가까이 와. 이 벤치에서 우리 사진을 찍고 싶어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 저녁 일찍, 너의 집에서. 함께 쉬고 나서, 너는 부엌으로 가서 저녁을 준비해.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내가 서빙하기 전에 한 조각 훔쳤다는 거지

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
Verdict?
Very good. I'm keeping the cook
That's a relief
Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 이제 네 음식이 식기 전에 맛봐.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 저녁 후에 너는 소파에 디저트를 가져와. {{name:lena}}가 너 옆에 다리를 접고, 너의 아픈 다리를 조심스럽게 피해. 영화를 틀지만, 대화하느라 계속 멈춰.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
What can I do?
Come here a second.
You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 더 가까이 다가가서 그녀에게 키스해. {{name:lena}}가 너를 더 가까이 끌어당기며 너의 입술에 미소를 지어.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
A Kiss on the Sofa
A LITTLE LATER
One more for today
You look very pleased with yourself
I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나는 공원 데이트, 저녁, 디저트, 그리고 너의 소파에서 아주 좋은 자리를 가졌어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 내 손님이야. 거기 앉아서 내 요리를 평가해도 돼.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 하지만 내가 너의 팔에 기대고 있었던 것 같아, 스무 분 동안

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
It's fine like this
Then I'd like to stay a little longer
I'd like that too
You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 테이블 위에 핸드폰을 두고 함께 편안히 앉아. 나머지 저녁은 대화와 키스로 지나가. {{name:lena}}가 결국 떠날 때, 너는 그녀를 문까지 데려다줘.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
Home ❤️
Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너의 손님은 채소를 썰 수 있어. 나에게 도마를 줘.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내 가방을 너의 소파 옆에 두고 왔어

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 좋아. 다시 오게 만드는 아주 설득력 있는 이유네

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
I know. I still want my bag 😌
Did the dinner live up to the promise?
Yes
But the best part was being there with you

Oh my god

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...

I can be a good person sometimes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 여름을 위해 몸매 유지하고 싶다면 특히 더 그래

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 안녕, 드디어 누가 우리 그룹 프로젝트에 대해 묻지 않고 식사할 시간이 생겼어 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 대화 중간에 중요한 부분을 숨긴 것 같은 기분이 들고 싶지 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 이제는 완전히 나답지 않게 대화를 시작하는 방법을 고민하고 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
