story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그는 내가 뭔가에 대해 이야기하고 싶어한다는 걸 알아. 하지만 그게 뭔지는 몰라

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
How did that feel?
Less terrifying than I expected
Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그가 내 점심을 훔치려고 했으니, 너무 진지하게 받아들일 수는 없었어

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내일은 좀 더 조용한 순간을 찾아볼게

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 다른 걸 결정하기 전에 우리가 실제로 그에 대해 이야기할 수 있는지 보고 싶어

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
I will
Thank you 😌
I downloaded an app during my break
You did?
Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그냥 어떤 느낌인지 보려고. 프로필도 올리지 않았고, 누구에게도 메시지를 보내지 않았어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 잠깐만, 프로필 화면으로 돌아가는 방법을 기억해보려고 해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
Okay, found it
It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 화면에 있는 모든 남자를 거대한 인생 결정처럼 대하지 않으니까 덜 위압적이었어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 한 남자는 같은 차 옆에서 찍은 사진이 여섯 장이나 있었어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 아마 그 차가 매력이 있나 봐.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 여기가 내 아주 특별한 점심 장소야

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 가족이라도 다른 사람들과 똑같이 대할 거야

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 너의 다리는 게으름 피우면 저절로 나아지지 않아

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 의사가 내 깁스를 제거한 건 겨우 어제였잖아, 기억하지?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 진짜 세션 시작할 때 울지 마

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
I might have given her a little push

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 안녕 😊 소파에서의 대모험은 성공했어, 아니면 게임기가 이겼어?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아마 바로는 아닐 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 내가 직접 만나서 이야기하고 싶은 이유 중 하나야. 필요하면 농담 그만하라고 할 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 제발 내가 그의 이름을 얼마나 빨리 말했는지 말하지 마.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 즉시 말하는 거야?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 말하니까 더 나쁘게 들리네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 세부사항은 빼둘 수 있어 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 우리 메시지를 그에게 보여주지 않을 거야. 내가 상황을 직접 설명할 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 감사합니다

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 그의 기분을 볼 수 있을 거야. 우리가 그 대화를 나누기 전에는 어디에도 초대하지 않을 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 기회가 되면 어떻게 지내는지 알려줘.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그런 다음 집에 와서 저녁을 만들었는데, 여섯 명 가족이 먹을 만큼의 파스타를 만들었더라고.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴게 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아까 짧은 소개를 썼어. 읽어볼래?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 보내.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 연애 중이고, 내 파트너는 내가 여기 있다는 걸 알아. 누군가를 알아가고 싶은데, 대화로 시작하고 커피 한 잔 할 수 있으면 좋겠어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 네가 말하고 싶은 걸 잘 표현해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너무 격식 차리는 것 같지 않아?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 조금 그래. 우리에 대한 게 아닌 너 자신에 대한 뭔가를 추가해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 실수로 파스타 여섯 인분을 요리하는 인상적인 능력 같은 거?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내일은 해결된 거네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 솔직히, 맞아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 조용한 카페, 형편없는 영화, 그리고 존재하지 않는 사람들을 위해 요리하는 걸 좋아해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 훨씬 더 너 같아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너도 파스타에 포함돼, 걱정하지 마 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐, 지금 빛이 좋을 때 사진 하나 찍어보고 싶어

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 완전히 공정한 의견을 줄게

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 처음이네

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2분 후

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아, 이건 진짜 나처럼 생겼네

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 아마 내 나머지 인생도.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 감자튀김 하나만 훔쳤다고 할 때 내 표정이야

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 순진해 보이는 게 아니라 진짜 순진해

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 사진이 정말 멋져. 법적 방어는 좀 더 다듬어야 해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 사진을 계속 가지고 있을게 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그걸 사용할게, 그리고 내일 뭔가 올리기 전에 서문을 다시 읽어볼게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 내가 진짜로 이야기하고 싶은 사람이 있는지 볼 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 누가 메시지를 보냈다고 해서 대화를 해야 할 필요는 없어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아. 나는 궁금할 뿐이지, 인터넷 전체에서 지원서를 받는 건 아니야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 좋은 프로필 제목이야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이제 너는 도움이 안 돼.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 다음에 좀 가져올 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내일이 너무 긴장돼.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하지만 내가 진짜로 하고 싶은 작은 일이라는 게 좋아, 거대한 도약을 준비하는 게 아니라.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 예상했던 것과 다르게 느껴지면 나한테 말해도 돼.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너도

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 그걸 꺼냈다고 해서 괜찮은 척하는 건 원하지 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 안 할 거야

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 자, 아주 중요한 질문이야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내 문제를 해결해주다니, 너 대단해!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 듣고 있어

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 너에게 파스타를 가져갈 때, 괜찮은 걸 볼 건지, 아니면 또 불을 켜지 않는 영화 보게 할 건지?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 분위기야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 내가 두 시간 동안 누가 문에 서 있는지 묻는 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이번엔 네가 고를 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 하지만 불평할 권리는 남겨둘게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 안 한다면 걱정할 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너와 함께하는 그 오후가 너무 좋고 싶어, 알지?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 또 다른 진지한 대화를 하려는 게 아니야. 그냥 너무 많이 먹고 너 옆에 앉아있고 싶어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐만, 다시 나를 방해하기 전에 편하게 좀 앉을게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 그게 좋아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 잊지 마. 나는 여전히 소파 자리를 차지할 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 네 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐만, 여기서 자버리기 전에 소파에서 침대로 옮길게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5분 후

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 거기. 너를 위해 다른 베개를 남겨둘게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 얼마나 그리운지 도와주지 않네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 네가 올 수 있을 때 와서 차지해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴게 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5분 후

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잘 자, 잘생긴 남자야 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잘 자. 나를 위해 파스타 좀 남겨줘.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리 둘 다 먹고도 남을 만큼 파스타가 있어. 자러 가 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 됐다. 머리는 아직 젖어있지만, 이제는 움직이지 않을 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너 지금 졸릴 것 같아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 주방에 갔다가 여러 번 돌아왔어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니야. 방금 앉았어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 보통 그렇게 시작하잖아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말 웃기네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 사실 내일 전에 확인하고 싶은 게 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 가서 말해봐.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지난 밤에, 내가 다른 사람에게 사진을 보낸다면 너가 알고 싶어 할 게 뭐냐고 물었잖아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너의 대답은 기억해. 하지만 우리가 할 수 있는 모든 걸 포함한다고 가정하고 싶진 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 맞는 말이야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 경험 많은 여행자네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 알고 싶고, 사진도 받고 싶다고 했잖아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 네가 공유하기로 선택한 것에 포함되는 게 좋더라.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 하지만 내가 누군가와 이야기하고 있다면, 내내 핸드폰만 쳐다보진 않을 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 매 5분마다 업데이트해달라고 하는 건 아니야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 공유하기로 결정한 사진은 보고 싶어. 대화는 다르니까.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 내가 타이핑을 안 한다고 해서 뭔가 잘못된 거라고 생각하며 메시지를 기다리게 하고 싶진 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 한가할 때 말해줘, 그러면 진짜로 이야기할 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 밖에서도 잠깐 시간을 보냈어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 더 좋네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 사진에 대해 너무 기대하지 마. 아직 첫 대화도 안 했어 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 정말 인내심을 가지고 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말 그럴듯하게 흉내 내고 있어!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 알고 싶다고 했지만, 꼭 사진을 원하지는 않는다고 했잖아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 여전히 맞아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너한테서 듣고 싶어. 보여줄 것들 모으는 건 필요 없어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말 안심이야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그런 다음 내 야망을 후회하기 전에 앉았어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 무슨 일이 있었는지 증명하는 것보다, 그게 어땠는지 말해주고 싶어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너 숙제 검사하는 거 아니야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 오늘은 그만했으면 해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 바쁘면 나중에 이야기해도 돼.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알겠어. 잠깐 시간이 생기면 말할게, 핸드폰으로 두 번째 대화를 이어가려고 애쓰는 것보다.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정확히!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그나저나, 내 평범한 사진은 여전히 받을 거야. 내 얼굴에서 그렇게 쉽게 도망칠 수는 없어 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴 생각은 없었어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그거 진짜 이성적으로 들리네.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 알고 싶지 않을 수도 있다고 했잖아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 각각의 일에 대해 모르고 싶다는 건지, 아니면 진행 중에 업데이트를 받지 않는 건지?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내 머릿속에서는 그걸 따로 생각해본 적이 없어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 내가 묻는 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 서프라이즈를 남겨두는 건 이해해. 단지 우리가 서로 다른 의미로 받아들이는 건 원하지 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 한계를 정하되, 몇 가지는 서프라이즈로 남겨두자.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그동안 업데이트는 없고, 나중에 이야기하는 게 더 좋아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 먼저 우리가 시도할 것에 대해 합의하고, 너가 모든 작은 것에 대해 말하지 않아도 되는 여지를 남겨두는 게 더 좋아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 우리가 실제로 이야기한 것 안에서의 서프라이즈지, 내가 그 답이 얼마나 멀리 가는지 추측하는 게 아니야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정확히!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너 놀란 것 같아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지금은 연락을 하고 첫 데이트가 괜찮은지 보는 것만 이야기하고 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아. 이걸 우리가 다른 모든 것에 이미 합의한 것처럼 다루고 있지 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 뭔가 잘못된 느낌이 들면, 꼭 말할게. 그 미스터리를 지키기 위해 혼자 간직하지 않을 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 물론이지. 나도 마찬가지야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 이제 더 이해가 가.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 일이 진행되는 동안 모든 걸 따라가고 싶진 않아.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하지만 그 후에는 어떻게 됐는지, 네 기분이 어땠는지 듣고 싶어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 나는 핸드폰을 치우고 대화를 나눈 다음, 내가 자유로울 때 이야기할 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이 순간을 망치지 않으려고 노력 중이야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 그게 내가 말하고 싶었던 것에 더 가까워.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 그렇게 할 수 있어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 만약 내가 더 빨리 너와 이야기해야 한다면, 그럴 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 당연히. 네가 나를 필요로 할 때 어떤 계획에 얽매일 필요 없어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지금 그걸 이야기해서 기뻐.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 계속 핸드폰을 보면서 내가 너에게 뭔가를 보내야 하는지 궁금해했어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그런 거 걱정하지 않았으면 해.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 당신의 나머지 하루는 어땠나요?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아. 우리가 실제로 말했으니 이제 더 쉬워.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 내일 뭐 하고 싶어?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 수업 끝나고 몇 분 이야기할 수 있는지 {{name:aiden}}에게 물어볼게.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 다른 사람과 데이트를 가는 것에 대해 이야기하고 있었다고 설명하고 싶어.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 그가 내가 그 대화를 나눌 수 있는 사람이라는 거야.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 네가 진지하다고 믿을 것 같아?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리는 프로젝트의 우리 부분을 끝냈으니, 드디어 그걸 생각하지 않아도 돼.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 어젯밤 이후로 그런 걸 제안할 줄은 몰랐어.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 너무 오래 걸리면 나 혼자 시작할 거야, 쓰레기 음식만 사서.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 오늘 밤 타코를 만들 수 있어.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
She has a permanent invitation
Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
How's your leg after yesterday?
A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 일어났을 때 좀 뻣뻣했지만, 조금 움직이니까 나아졌어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
What are you planning?
A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 오늘 아침 집안일 좀 하고, 나중에 아마 게임할 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
I'm spending the afternoon with my family
I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 내 가방을 찾으려다 그 위치를 기억해냈어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 먼저 점심. 그 다음에 카드 게임을 할 거래

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 내가 통보받았어. 내 참여는 선택 사항이 아니었어 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 더 높은 목표를 세울 거야. 이길 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 그리고 나서 그들이 나를 감탄하게 해줄 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
Exactly
Okay, I need to get ready
It's still beside the sofa
Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 내 가방 안전하게 보관해줘. 너를 볼 때 가져갈게

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
You too love
At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 적어도 우리 중 한 명은 어젯밤 너의 집에 있었어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
Then don't get too attached to it 😌
Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 이미 늦었어. 우리는 이미 아침을 먹었어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 대신 초대했어야 할 사람 여기 있어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 너도 제일 큰 난장판을 만들고 있잖아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
Did you just take a picture of me?
While I have sauce on my face?
You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 타코 양념이 묻어있을 때 그런 말 하면 안 돼
네가 거의 네 번째를 사려고 했잖아.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 내가 이렇게 차분한 건 익숙해지지 마

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 타코가 거의 다 준비됐으니까 이렇게 된 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 이제 그만 말하고 접시에 담는 거 도와줘

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 연기 경고음이 울리지 않을 때 10점을 아껴두고 있어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 네가 연기 경고음을 울리지 않을 때 말이야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
I’m exhausted in the best way
It helped more than I expected
I might start requesting weekly taco nights
Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 내가 적어도 한 가방은 들고 있었다는 증거야.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
She sends you a kiss back 😘
But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내가 기분 좋게 보일 때마다 누군가 더 그리게 해

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
Did you keep a straight face?
Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그때 누군가 왜 내가 범죄를 숨기고 있는 것 같냐고 물어봤어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 가혹하네. 나는 제한된 정보로 작업하고 있었어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그들이 내가 누구한테 계속 문자를 보내냐고 물어봤어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내 남자친구가 나를 지게 도와준다고 말했어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그들이 너를 그리워할 기회를 줘. 잠깐 쉬어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 그랬어. 또 케이크 한 조각 가져올 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
I'll be home later this afternoon
I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 좋은 생각이 있어. 집에 가면 말해줄게 ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 좋아. 내 아주 중요한 케이크 먼저 끝내고 할게

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 내가 이길 것 같으면 모두 갑자기 경쟁적으로 변해

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
You look like you're planning revenge

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 늦은 저녁 — 집으로 돌아와 잠시 혼자 조용한 시간을 보낸다.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
Yeah. I'd love to play with you
You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 항상 재밌게 노는 것 같아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그냥 듣는 것보다 너랑 해보고 싶었어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그럼 우리 둘 다 즐길 수 있는 걸 찾아보자

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 좋아. 개인 레이스를 할 수 있어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 조금 후 — 둘이 레이싱 게임을 시작해. 시작하기 전에 조작법을 설명하고 {{name:lena}}에게 연습 랩을 해보게 해.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 아주 전문적이네. 연습 랩은 어떻게 되고 있어?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 코너 전에 브레이크를 밟고, 그 다음에 방향을 틀어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 두 가지를 모두 전속력으로 하려고 하고 있어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 도로 위에 있는 것도 도움이 돼

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 좋아. 한 번 더 연습 랩 할게

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
And I have a very serious question
You finished so far ahead of me 😭
I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나는 그걸 훨씬 많이 해봤어. 네 첫 번째 레이스와 비교하지 마

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 하지만 너는 마지막 코너를 깔끔하게 돌았잖아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그게 너가 연습할 때 계속 부딪혔던 거잖아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 봐? 벌써 타이밍을 잘 잡고 있어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
Same track?
Yes. I have unfinished business with it
I'm listening
AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 두 번째 경주 후 — {{name:lena}}는 여전히 너보다 뒤에 있지만, 사고는 더 적게 나고 트랙을 완주해.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
Check your time, though
You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 첫 번째 경주보다 훨씬 빨리 끝냈어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그리고 나는 겨우 두 번만 돌았어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 정확해. 날카로운 코너 전에 속도를 줄이는 걸 기억했네

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
They worked. That was a much better lap
You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내가 너의 여자친구라서 착하게 굴고 있네

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 실력이 안 늘었으면 솔직히 말했을 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 더 빠른 랩은 네가 더 잘 운전했기 때문이야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 멈추고 싶어, 아니면 다른 트랙을 해볼래?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 사고 없이 할 수 있는지 보고 싶어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
I nearly had it
You only clipped the barrier at the end
Because I got excited and forgot to brake
Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너의 전반부는 정말 좋았어. 계속 그렇게 하면 나머지도 잘 될 거야

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 잠깐만. 네가 나한테 게임하자고 하는 거야?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
I'd be very happy with that
You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내가 물어본 것 때문에 아직도 웃고 있지?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너와 이걸 나눌 수 있어서 좋아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나도. 네가 잡기 힘들게 귀찮게 해도

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 이제 내가 항상 한 번 더 하고 싶어하는 이유를 알겠지

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
Did you play games like this when you were little?
Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 응. 컨트롤러를 그렇게 기울이면 내가 방향을 바꿀 수 있을 것 같았어

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
I did that tonight 😭
Then you have excellent instincts
Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 차를 제외한 모든 사람이 내가 원하는 걸 이해한 것 같아

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 다음 번에는 차도 함께 참여하도록 할게

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 오늘 밤 나에게 인내심을 가져줘서 고마워

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 재미있었어. 네가 이길 필요는 없어, 나랑 노는 게 즐거우니까

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 잘 자, 사랑아. 나한테 놀자고 해줘서 고마워

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
Why are you so surprised?
You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
