Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 모든 걸 정리했어. 오늘 밤 공부는 끝났어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 오늘 고마워. 유용한 부분도, 소파에서의 부분도 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나도 그랬어. 특히 노트북을 닫고 나서의 부분이 좋았어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 이제 다시 전체를 리허설하기 전에 잠잘 준비를 하고 있어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
Goodnight, love
Goodnight ❤️

{{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}가 슬라이드를 열고 발표를 시작해. 너는 그녀가 어떻게 품질, 편리함, 개인 서비스가 고객을 다시 오게 할 수 있는지 설명하는 걸 들어. 중간에 그녀는 잠시 멈추고 노트를 내려다봐.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
Can I ask something?
Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 응. 그게 네가 여기 온 이유야.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 두 곳이 같은 가격에 같은 물건을 팔면, 누가 하나를 선택하게 만드는 걸까?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 경험이야. 거기서 쇼핑하기 쉬운지, 직원들이 도와주는지...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그거 이해가 가. 그 섹션을 질문으로 시작하는 건 어때?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 응. 먼저 예시를 보여줘, 그 다음에 설명해줘.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나 나갔어. 우리 음식을 가져오고 바로 갈게 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그녀는 질문을 노트에 추가하고 두 개의 동네 카페를 예로 들어 그 섹션을 다시 시도해. 이번에는 멈추지 않고 잘 해냈어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나는 그 모든 걸 잘 따라갔어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 아니, 네가 무슨 뜻인지 이해했어. 그러니까 정의가 더 이해가 갔어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
Actually?
Don't ruin your good work.
20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20분 후 — {{name:lena}}가 발표를 마치고, 시간을 확인한 후 노트북을 닫아. 너는 그녀의 결론에 대해 마지막 질문을 하고, 그녀는 노트를 보지 않고 대답해.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
How was work?
You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 두 번째 시도에서 너도 더 많이 쳐다봤어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내가 할 때마다 너는 나를 똑바로 쳐다봤어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그랬어. 그리고 그런 관객이 있어서 좋았어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
{{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}가 네 의자 옆으로 와서 너에게 키스하려고 몸을 숙여.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 내가 그 노트북을 닫기를 기다리고 있었지, 그치?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나는 규칙을 지키고 있었어. 네가 끝날 때까지 키스는 안 돼.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 발표 걱정할 시간도 없을 만큼 바빴어

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 이제 관객인 척하는 건 그만해도 될까?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 여기 오기 위해 발표가 필요하지 않았어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그리고 너와 저녁을 보내고 싶었어. 이게 잘 풀렸네.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.

25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25분 후 — 식사 후, 너는 소파로 이동해. {{name:lena}}가 너 옆에 가까이 앉아, 너의 회복 중인 다리를 위해 공간을 남겨둬. 너의 팔이 그녀의 어깨에 감기고, 그녀는 너를 향해 돌아서서 또 한 번 키스를 해.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
The table wasn't that bad.
I couldn't sit like this there.
I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 우리 샌드위치 가져왔어. 잠시 후에 봐

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
After the Sandwiches
Your hand is wandering.
You can tell me to stop.
I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그만하라고 한 건 아니야. 더 위로.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
And the other one?
You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그것도 가져도 돼. 아래로. 나는 이미 결정했어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너 때문에 저녁을 예의 바르게 유지하기가 너무 힘들어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
See you soon
My turn too.
You don't have to.
I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 알아. 하고 싶어. 청바지 좀 열어봐.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
Tell me if that's too much.
It isn't.
On the Sofa
There. That was the point.
You look very pleased with yourself.
I am. You can thank me later
A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 조금 후 — {{name:lena}}가 그녀의 노트와 음식 가방을 들고 네 집에 도착해. 너는 그녀를 키스로 맞이하고, 샌드위치를 주방에 두고 함께 테이블에 앉아.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25분 후 — 정리한 후, 그녀가 너에게 기대어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
Yes. Are you?
Very.
Then stop moving away to talk.
I was going to ask about your day.
How was university?
Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 괜찮아. 하지만 점심시간에 제대로 먹지 않고 그 서문을 다시 썼어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 매우 중요했어. 내가 산만해지기 전에 발표 도와줘서 고마워.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 좋아. 열 분 동안 내 남자친구가 아닌 척 해줘.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 여기 오기 전에 네가 대부분의 일을 했잖아.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 네가 내가 소리 내서 말할 수 있게 도와줬어. 그게 내가 필요했던 부분이야.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20분 후 — 나중에, {{name:lena}}가 시간을 확인하고 노트를 챙겨. 그녀는 노트북을 치우고, 두 가방을 들고 너와 함께 문 옆에 서.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 응. 나를 다시 초대할 이유가 전혀 없게 두고 가.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 하나 없이도 잘 지낼 것 같아.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
{{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}가 가방을 잠시 내려놓고 너에게 다가와. 그녀가 너에게 작별 키스를 하고, 한 손은 너의 어깨에, 너의 팔은 그녀의 허리를 감싸.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
Okay. Now I'm really going.
That's a difficult opening request.
Text me when you get home.
I will. Love you.
Love you too.
{{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}가 두 가방을 들고 나가. 너는 테이블을 정리하고 저녁 나머지를 위해 자리를 잡아.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
Home ❤️ Both bags made it
Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
No. I checked twice
And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그리고 짐을 풀면서 그 어려운 부분을 다시 시도해봤어.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그럼 관객 중 한 평범한 사람이야. 내가 끝날 때까지 나를 키스할 수 없어.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
He moved it earlier than usual
Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그냥 그의 일정에 더 잘 맞는다고 했어.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
I kept waking up for no reason
Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그냥 침대에 누워서 천장을 멍하니 쳐다봤어.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그냥 머리가 너무 많이 생각하는 아침이야.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 안녕 ❤️ 오늘 밤에 뭐 필요한 거 있어?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 계속 깨긴 했지만, 움직이면 괜찮아질 거야

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 꽤 잘 지냈어, 오늘 아침에 우편함까지 갔다 왔어

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 다른 사람에게 물어보지 않아도 되는 기분이 좋았겠네

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그랬어, 비록 내가 모은 게 쓰레기 우편물뿐이었지만

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 모든 노력에 대한 실망스러운 보상이야 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
What's on the menu tonight?
Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 치킨과 밥이야, 설명서 필요 없는 거

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너만 오면 돼, 나머지는 내가 할게

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
You remembered?
You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 여기 있을 때 항상 찾잖아

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 디저트는 내가 가져갈게, 그건 내가 할게

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 완벽해, 싸움 없이 결정 하나 했네

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 다섯 시에 끝나. 가는 길에 들러서 바로 올게

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
You didn't have to do everything
I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 밤 이렇게 할 수 있어서 기뻐

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
You're not ready yet?
Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 거의 다 됐어, 너랑 이야기하면서 한 쪽 귀걸이만 하고 있었어 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 몇 분 후, 그녀가 떠나기 전에...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 자, 양쪽 귀걸이 다 하고 준비 완료야 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
Thank you ❤️
It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
Have a good day
You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20분 후 — 저녁을 먹으면서, 너는 그녀를 위해 사온 레모네이드를 따라. 그녀는 병을 보고, 다시 너를 봐. "냉장고에 넣어놨네," 그녀가 말해. "따뜻한 레모네이드는 안 좋게 평가될 것 같았어." 그녀는 웃지만, 잠시 조용해지더니 너의 손을 잡으려고 테이블을 넘어와.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 저녁 식사 중 대화가 풀려. 그녀가 아침에 있었던 일을 이야기하고, 네 접시에서 치킨 한 조각을 훔쳐가. 네가 알아차리면, 그녀는 네 접시에 바삭한 가장자리가 있었다고 주장해. 두 조각의 타르트를 꺼내면, 그녀는 어느 게 더 큰지 결정하려는 너의 시도를 보고 웃어.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20분 후 — 너의 접시를 치우는 걸 도와준 후, 그녀는 소파 옆에 신발을 두고 좋은 쿠션을 차지해. 그녀는 너 옆에 앉으면서 머리에서 타이를 풀어. 영화가 시작되기 전에, 그녀는 너의 어깨에 기대고 둘의 사진을 찍어. 그녀는 너에게 보관할 수 있도록 복사본을 보내.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그건 그의 집에 가는 거랑 같은 말이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 동기 부여를 잘하는 교수님이 있으면 그런 거지 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
{{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 너가 힘들어하는 거 보는 게 더 재밌어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 온몸이 아프고, 머리도 엉망이고, 반 죽은 것처럼 보이네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 안녕 😊 알람 울리기 전에 깼는데, 오후 3시 반까지 일주일은 남은 기분이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 네 감정을 가장 중요하지 않은 부분처럼 대하는 걸 그만두길 바래.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 노력 중이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 만들어내야 하는 어떤 모습이 아니라, 나로서 이걸 해주길 바라는 게 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그게 내가 사랑하는 여자야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 너무 달콤했어 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이제 네가 주방 테이블에서 나를 웃게 만들기 전에 찾고 있던 걸 잊어버렸어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 열쇠?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 맞아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나를 봐, 유용하고 매력적이지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이걸 망치지 말자.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나중에 준비할 때 문자할게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋은 아침이야. 그리고 회의가 점심시간을 삼키기 전에 먹어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 정말 내 일을 빼앗고 있네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 내가 만든 것보다 훨씬 좋아 보인다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 싱크대에서 먹는 대신 접시에 뭔가 담아보는 건 어때?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 여기 없었어. 아무것도 증명할 수 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 너를 알아

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 아침에 그룹 미팅이 있어, 그 후에 집에 가서 옷을 갈아입을게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어제 입었던 드레스 아직도 입고 있어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응. 그 결정을 다시 시작하는 건 거부할 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 가기 전에 너한테 뭔가 물어보고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 뭔데?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 다시 자도 돼. 6월에 깨워줄게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘에 대한 거야. 한계에 대해서, 아마.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 나중에 알고 싶어하는 것에 대해서는 이야기했지만, 이건 좀 다르지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 우리가 커피라고 했을 때, 커피만 의미한 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아니. 너가 만날 장소를 정한 거지, 오후가 어디서 끝나야 한다는 규칙은 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그래서 잘 되면 더 있고 싶으면, 우리가 언급한 것만으로 집에 돌아가야 하는 건 아니지?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 당연히 아니지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 하고 싶은 걸 하길 원해, 오늘 아침에 만든 목록에 있는지 계속 확인하지 말고.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럼 내가 그를 키스하고 싶으면?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럼 키스해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 그걸 너무 쉽게 말하네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정말 도움이 되네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 진심이니까.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럼 내가 더 나아가고 싶으면?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너에게 한계를 두지 않을 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 정하는 한계는 없어. 네가 원하는 걸 결정하길 원해, 내가 원하는 걸 생각하지 말고.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정말?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정말로. 매 단계마다 내게 허락을 구할 필요 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아직 어떤 기분일지 모르겠어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 미리 알 필요 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 커피 한 잔 하고 가거나, 오후 내내 같이 있고 싶을 수도 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 계획에 맞추려고 스스로를 억제하거나, 나를 위해 이야기를 더 흥미롭게 만들려고 애쓰지 않았으면 해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어젯밤은 괜찮았어. 지금은 주전자가 끓는 동안 시간을 확인하고 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그게 내가 걱정했던 부분이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 집에 돌아와서 너무 많은 걸 했거나, 충분히 하지 못해 너를 실망시킨 기분이 드는 게 싫어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘을 성공적으로 만들기 위해 해야 할 일은 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그래서 내가 진짜 원하는 걸 결정하고, 그가 원하는 것도 알아볼게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정확히!

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 중간에 마음을 바꿀 수도 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 당연하지. 이건 너가 우리 둘 중 누구에게도 약속하는 게 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 알겠어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 예상했던 것보다 훨씬 큰 대답이네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 물어보기 전에 이미 아침 먹었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어젯밤에 갑자기 훨씬 더 현실감이 느껴진다고 했잖아. 그게 바뀌었어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 완전히는 아니야. 네가 실제로 거기 있다는 걸 생각할 때 여전히 느껴져.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 하지만 긴장한다고 해서 네 결정을 대신해주고 싶진 않아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 편안해지는 걸 나를 위해 해야 할 또 다른 일로 만들지 마.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 안 할게. 뭔가 다르게 느껴지면 말해줄게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 네가 진짜 대답을 해주길 원해, 시간이 걸리더라도.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 기억했구나 ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어젯밤처럼 여전히 웃고 있어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응. 조금 산만하기도 한데, 네 기분이 어떤지 듣는 게 기대돼.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 집을 나서기도 전에 내 오후가 어떻게 될지 결정하지 마.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 대신 나한테 계속 문자를 보내는 여자애에게 집중하려고 하고 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그녀는 정말 사랑스러워 보이네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그녀는 ❤️야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 자기 전에 내일 강의가 들릴 것 같았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}도 그렇다고? 우리가 나중에 그를 또 볼 거라는 걸 알면서?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응. 우리가 누구에 대해 이야기하고 있는지 잊지 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 난 너를 믿어. 내가 이상하게 느끼지 않도록 온 데이트 내내 나를 보호해 달라고 하는 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘은 그가 잠깐 시간이 필요할지도 몰라.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어제 일을 아직 이해하려고 하고 있어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아마도. "내 남자친구가 알아"라는 말이 아직 완전히 자리 잡았는지 잘 모르겠어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 다시 놀라게 하기 전에 그가 뭘 주문하게 해줘.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 두 번째 발표는 안 할 거야. 그는 잘 해낼 수 있어 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 좋은 영향을 주는 거라고 해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 아직 잘 모르는 사람을 만나는 중이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정확해. 선택할 자유가 있다고 해서 갑자기 그에게 모든 걸 믿어야 하는 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 여전히 커피 한 잔 하면서 그가 어떤 사람인지 보고 싶어. 그건 변하지 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럼 거기서 시작하면 돼.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그의 메시지가 마음에 들었어. 내가 상상한 모습과 맞는지 고민하며 데이트를 보내고 싶지 않아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 실제 사람을 더 흥미롭게 느낄 수도 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그가 요리는 카페에 맡긴다면, 우리는 기회가 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 먹었어, 아니면 다른 사람들만 감독하고 있는 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 네가 내가 몇 가지는 나만 알고 있어도 된다고 했을 때, 우리는 첫 데이트에 대해서만 이야기했잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 대답이 더 의미가 있는 것처럼 여기기 전에 이 부분을 소리 내어 말하고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 그렇게 해줘서 고마워. 이제 내가 너에게 커피 때문에 멈추지 말고 스스로 선택하길 바란다는 걸 알겠지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 어떤 것들은 우리가 서로 오해하지 않고도 내 것일 수 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응. 그리고 서로 걱정되는 건 여전히 이야기해야 해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 허용된 것에 대해 아주 조심스러운 대답을 해줄 줄 알았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 여기 음식 있어, 고마워.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 책 사는 데 예상보다 오래 걸렸어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
{{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 그 인사는 볼 때마다 덜 가볍게 느껴진다. 이제 내 반응도 눈에 들어온다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK가 {{name:hailey}}가 {{name:aiden}}의 도착 시 뺨에 키스를 시작한 증거를 보관함

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?
He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 그가 나를 잘 챙겨줘서 작은 보상을 줘야지
너희 둘 다 말도 안 돼

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 주제가 노출이 심한 옷을 입고 두 남자 앞을 일부러 걸어감

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 둘이 가까워지고 있다는 건 보인다. 그래도 내가 얼마나 편하게 받아들일 수 있는지는 아직 생각해 봐야 한다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK가 {{name:hailey}}가 노는 법을 배우겠다는 핑계로 {{name:aiden}}의 무릎에 앉은 것을 기록함

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
I have a training session later
It was fun hanging out with you guys
Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 너희 둘, 그거 사적으로 할 수 있어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 그게 도전이라면 더 과감하게 할 거야 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 오늘 아침에 대가를 치르게 될 거라고 경고했잖아

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 안녕 😊 집에 돌아왔고 준비 중이야, 드레스는 세 번 다시 고려해도 살아남았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그런가 봐. 나는 한 챕터를 놓친 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
Did you talk again before coming here?
This morning, yes
And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그래? 그게 어땠는지 물어봐도 돼, 아니면 그건 비밀이야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 일부는 비밀이야. 하지만 커피가 한계인지 물어봤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
Yes
What did he say?
That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그는 나에게 한계를 정하고 싶지 않대. 내가 하고 싶은 걸 결정하길 원해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
Seriously? Just like that?
We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우린 그보다 더 오래 얘기했어. 유용한 부분만 줄게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그 대화를 나누면서 표정을 유지하는 걸 상상해보려고 해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
Fair point
It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우리 데이트 내내 다시 설명하지 않으면 이상할 수 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그리고 오늘 어떻게 끝날지에 대한 약속을 가지고 온 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 알아. 그건 내가 너에게 물어봐야 한다는 뜻이지, 그가 뭐에 동의했는지 추측하려고 하지 말고.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
Exactly
All right. First question for you, then
Go on
Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 진짜 창가 자리를 원해, 아니면 내가 여기 앉아 있어서 다른 자리를 선택한 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
Then swap with me
Really?
Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 응. 너도 의자를 선택할 수 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 이제 이거 가지고 엄청 귀찮게 굴 거지?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 네가 선호가 없다고 pretending하는 걸 그만두기 전까지만.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너가 이게 너무 과하다고 생각하는지 물어보려 했는데, 사실 내가 이걸 좋아한다는 걸 깨달았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 서로 궁금해한다는 건 알고 있었다. 그래도 둘이 서로에게 집중하는 모습을 보면 놀라게 된다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
Caught Looking
AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
Is it good?
Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 아주 맛있어. 네 것도 작아도 즐길 수 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
That's why you keep coming back
That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 시간을 안 보고 여기 온 적이 없는 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
Then keep that answer
Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 오늘은 습관적으로 노트를 가방에 넣고 올 뻔했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 미안. 네가 여기 오기로 선택한 게 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그건 정말 불편할 정도로 좋은 대답이네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 알아. 그냥 항상 그 뒤에 농담이 세 개는 있어야 들어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
You don't need to stop being funny
I will ❤️
Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 좋아, 잘생기고 조용한 건 힘들 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 완전한 오후가 자유롭다면 뭐 할 거야? 해야 할 일 말고, 진짜로 하고 싶은 거.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 얼마나 걸렸는지 세지 않고 산책하곤 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 어딘가에 앉아서 뭔가 듣고, 잠시 수업 그룹에 답장 안 해도 될 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 몇 블록 떨어진 곳에 정원이 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그곳 알아. 나는 항상 입구를 지나쳐.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
Yes. I'd like that
LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
How are you feeling otherwise?
Left here, isn't it?
Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 응. 같은 블록을 계속 돌고 싶지 않다면.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 너에게 투어를 해주는 척할 수도 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
It needs work
A little
You're being suspiciously quiet
You were worried I'd make a joke
I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 너에게 아예 말을 멈추라고 한 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 좋은 시간을 보내고 있어. 모든 조용한 순간을 채우고 싶진 않아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 긴장되긴 한데, 취소했으면 좋겠다는 생각은 안 해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
A little
I like it
A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
This is nicer than the path outside
You can hear yourself think in here
I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 오늘은 그런 거 좀 덜 하길 바랐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
Better once we left the café
Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 커피 마실 때 그렇게 별로였어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 뭔가 해야 할 때의 10분 전처럼, 머릿속에 할 말이 다 떨어지는 기분이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 아니, 다음에 뭘 해야 할지 상상하는 걸 그만뒀어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
Now I'd like you to stop for a second
Here?
Yes
Okay
You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 뭔가 위험한 말을 하려는 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그럼 내가 좀 조급해진 걸 수도 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
Contact reciprocated
A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 키스가 있으니 말로만 나누던 때와는 다르게 현실이 된다. 그걸 받아들일 시간이 조금 필요하다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
To Shut Him Up
Hey
I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 먼저 그렇게 하라고 한 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너가 걷는 걸 멈추고 나를 그렇게 쳐다봤잖아. 내가 위험을 감수했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그건 위험이 아니었어. 너가 앞서 나간 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그래서 내가 이 상황이 어떻게 흘러갈지 맞혔네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 지금 너 스스로가 정말 뿌듯해 보인다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
You were about to kiss me anyway
Keep talking and see what happens
A radical suggestion
I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그 결정을 다시 시작하지 않을 거라고 생각했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
Shush
So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 솔직히 말해봐, 누가 더 잘 키스해? 나 아니면 그?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
What? It's a valid question
You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너는 모든 걸 경쟁으로 만들어. 게임에서, 수업에서, 인생에서.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 정말 알고 싶다면, 지금은 너가 아직 많이 뒤쳐져 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
You asked
No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 아니, 난 좋아. 이제 도전처럼 들리네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너무 늦었어. 난 이미 개인적으로 받아들이고 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그런데 너는 나를 조용히 하려고 키스했잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 이건 지금 내게 말이 얼마나 효과적인지를 말해줘.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
Yes. Over there, in the shade
Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 봐봐. 심문 없이 앉고 싶은 곳이 생겼네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
LATER THAT AFTERNOON
Shall I walk you back to the stop?
I'd like that
Do you want to make plans for another day now?
Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 지금은 아니야. 오늘을 좀 음미하고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
That isn't a polite way of saying no
I didn't take it as one
Good. I'm glad we did this
So am I
Text me when you're home?
I will
AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
I'm glad. How are you feeling?
Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 모든 걸 한 번에 쓰고 싶을 줄 알았어. 주로 그냥 잠깐 앉아있고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 천천히 해. 집에 가는 걸 보고서로 만들 필요 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 알아. 그래도 너에게 이걸 보내고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 진짜로 오후를 쉬었던 것 같은 기분이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그냥 내가 해야 할 두 가지 사이의 간격이 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 집에 정착하면 제대로 이야기할 수 있을까?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너의 하루도 좀 들려줘. 내 이야기만 할 순 없잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 그에게 내가 가는 중이라고 빠른 사진을 보냈어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 들어가기 전에 이 사진을 찍었어. 거기 빛이 많이 들어오는 게 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 쇼핑 거리 근처 카페에 있어. 큰 창가 옆에 자리를 잡았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 일찍 와서 음료 고르는 게 아주 복잡한 일인 척하고 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
You would think so
Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 잠깐, 그가 밖에 있어. 사진에서 본 얼굴이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 이거야, 내가 너에게 보낸 거울 사진 말고.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우리는 주문했고, 함께 사진 찍는 게 괜찮은지 물어봤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그가 괜찮다고 했어. 너한테도 보내고 싶다고 말했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 사람과 실제로 이야기하는 게 첫 문장을 상상하는 것보다 쉬워.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 커피 맛있게 마셔. 나중에 어떻게 지내는지 말해줘.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
LATER THAT AFTERNOON
Beyond the Coffee
A LITTLE LATER
An Unplanned Goodbye
LATER
I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
How are you feeling?
Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 좋아. 음료 메뉴를 시험 보듯이 공부하던 때보다 나아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 대화를 다 이끌지 않아도 돼서 좋았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
Was he like you expected?
A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 사실 처음엔 좀 조용했어. 그래서 긴장한 게 덜 어색하게 느껴졌어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그 다음에 피자 사진 설명하는 데 첫 10분을 쓰지 않겠다고 다짐했다고 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
For about four minutes
I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그 이야기를 듣고 싶어서 물어본 거지, 그가 할 말이 없어서가 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 결국 나중에 돌아다녔어. 원래 살 생각 없던 중고 책도 하나 사왔어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 두 장 찍었어. 첫 번째 사진에서는 내가 문을 잠갔는지 기억하려고 하는 것 같았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 완전히 필요 없는 구매였지만, 마음에 들어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 긴장이 풀리고 나서 그곳에 있는 게 즐거웠어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 응. 잘 되고 있는지 고민하는 걸 멈추고 그냥 즐겼어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 작은 세부사항은 나만 알고 있을게, 하지만 그 부분은 너에게 알려주고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
So am I ❤️
I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우리가 작별 인사한 후에 이걸 찍었어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 변경하는 건 아니야. 그냥 불필요하게 집중해서 보고 있는 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
I am. And hungry again somehow
I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 집에 가서 제대로 이야기하기 전에 밥 좀 먹고 싶어, 괜찮아?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
I still want to hear about your day too
It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너의 이야기가 내 이야기와 경쟁할 필요는 없어, 흥미롭기만 하면 돼

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 세탁기랑 국제적인 사건을 일으키지 않고 세탁했어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 아직 안에 있었어. 그래서 아니야 😭.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그 과정에서 양말 하나가 잃어버렸을지도 몰라

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 안 했으면 너는 불평했을 거야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 불평하는 게 아니야. 너가 얼마나 칭찬받을 자격이 있는지 결정 중이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그럼 잘했어, 잘생긴 남자. 오늘 밤 더 긴 버전 이야기해줄게 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그런데, 내가 가는 중이라고 그에게 빠른 사진을 보냈어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그냥 문 앞에 있는 나, 특별한 건 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 알아. 어차피 너는 내 거울 점검을 다 받았잖아

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 복도에 서 있을 이유를 더 찾기 전에 나갈게

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 재미있게 놀아. 네가 한가할 때 얘기하자

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 다음에 뭘 원할지 생각하면서 데이트할 필요 없어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그룹 미팅이 제시간에 끝났어, 그래서 제대로 점심도 먹었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그럼 나도 일찍 왔다는 걸 알겠지

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 좀 더 매력적인 면이 있다고 생각하고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 좋아. 너는 데이트 내내 케이크 진열대만 쳐다보지 않겠네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너 때문에 지금 하나 생각해보고 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 자, 봐. 흔들리지 않는 의자 두 개 찾았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 사진을 찍는 거야, 아니면 사진에 나오는 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Being in it. I can hold the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 사진에 나오는 거지. 내가 전화기를 들고 있을게.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a separate issue

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나도 하나 원해. 근데 그래, 그에게 보내고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. You can send it to me as well
Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그럼 좀 더 가까이 와. 아니면 너의 어깨만 찍히겠어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have just asked

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우리가 테이블을 찾았어 😊 그가 커피에 대해 불평하기 전에 사진을 요청했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너희 둘이 메뉴 가지고 싸울 것 같아 보인다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We already did. This is the peaceful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 우린 이미 싸웠어. 지금은 평화로운 부분이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted to show you before I leave
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 떠나기 전에 너에게 보여주고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
So, how did this morning go?
We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 사실 일을 끝냈어. 나가려고 내 노트북이 고장 날 것처럼 굴 필요가 없었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그거 실망이네. 네가 나를 위해 도망쳤다고 생각하고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너는 오후를 가져. 극적인 배경 이야기를 요구하지 마.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 너 얼굴에 그 표정은 한동안 잊지 못할 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 내가 너한테 flirt할 때 그가 짜증낼 거라고 몇 년을 기대했어. 이렇게 될 줄은 몰랐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그는 너랑 게임 가지고 싸우는 것만 있는 게 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Did you tell him you’d be back later?
Then we can continue the lesson
This has moved well past a study session, and it's harder to laugh off now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 이건 공부 시간이라는 선을 한참 넘었다. 이제 웃어넘기기가 더 어렵다.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived the first kiss of the evening session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK가 저녁 세션의 첫 키스를 기록함

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I also have ways to give punishments and rewards… without being the teacher 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 나도 선생님이 아니어도 벌과 보상을 줄 수 있는 방법이 있어… 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject initiated a handjob during the private session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 주제가 개인 세션 중에 손으로 해주기를 시작함

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On this subject… you don’t seem to need any lessons
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 이 주제에 대해… 너는 수업이 필요 없어 보이네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’ll probably go revise directly at his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 아마 그의 집에서 바로 수정할 거야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we still need to revise now
But it’s going to be hard to focus after that 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 그런데 그거 하고 나면 집중하기 힘들 것 같아 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’ll drop me off a bit later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 조금 이따 나를 데려다 줄 거야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know… but we have to

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 너 그 쇼 좋아한 거 알아 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little reward just for you

I’m done living only for revisions

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 내 앞에서 그런 거 부끄럽지 않아?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 바로 네가 영화를 고르는 방식이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇게 대화가 흘러가는 게 좋았어. 첫 데이트라는 생각은 잊어버렸어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그를 상상했던 것과 다른 점이 있었어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 메시지에서 예상했던 것보다 대답하기 전에 더 오래 들었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 처음엔 내가 뭔가 어색한 말을 했나 싶었어. 그런데 그가 내가 물어본 것에 대해 진지하게 생각하고 있다는 걸 깨달았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 항상 나쁜 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니. 모든 공백을 메우려 하지 않으니 좋았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 우리가 만나는 걸 너가 알고 있는지 확인했지만, 내가 거기 있는 걸 변명해야 할 것처럼 너를 계속 언급하진 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 그가 뭔가 확실하지 않으면 나에게 물어봤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 드디어 제대로 앉았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그거 너를 알아가는 좋은 방법 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇게 느껴졌어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 걷는 동안 손을 잡고 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 서점 밖에서 그에게 키스해도 되는지 물어봤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너도 하고 싶었어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리가 작별 인사를 할 준비를 하고 있었고, 나는 다른 이유를 생각해 보려 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 내가 진짜 원하는 걸 말했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그도 그걸 원했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그랬어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 말을 찾는 게 조금 어색했어. 하지만 키스는 그렇지 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 후에 나는 집으로 가는 내내 궁금해하는 대신 물어본 게 기뻤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇게 편하게 해줘서 고마워!

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 그래. 오늘 아침에 두 번째 술을 마실지 고민했거든.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하루 만에 그를 잘 안다고는 할 수 없지만, 우리가 보낸 오후는 정말 즐거웠어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 오늘 밤은 더 큰 결정을 내릴 필요 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아. 그에게 만나는 게 즐거웠다고 했고, 다시 이야기할 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리가 말했듯이, 모든 순간을 설명할 필요는 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
