story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴 필요 없어. 너는 어떻게 지내?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 행복해. 조금 생각이 많지만, 화나진 않아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그곳에 있고 싶어서 있었고, 집에 가고 싶을 때 떠났어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 오후를 특정 시간 동안 지속시키거나 더 큰 무언가로 만들려고 한 건 아니야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하고 싶은 말을 편하게 할 수 있었어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 머릿속에서 모든 걸 연습하는 걸 멈추니까 더 편해졌어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지금은 나만 알고 싶은 것들도 있지만, 너에게 말하기 꺼리는 걱정거리는 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 나에게 중요해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 모든 이유를 설명하지 않고도 즐거웠다고 말할 수 있어서 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 모든 세부사항을 몰라도 너를 위해 행복할 수 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 완전 그래. 그 신발은 잘 선택했지만, 들어오자마자 벗고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 나도 행복해 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 어땠어? 오늘 너의 하루는 어땠어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너와 만날 거라는 걸 알았을 때, 평소보다 시간을 더 자주 확인했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 다음에 전화를 내려놓고 오후를 보냈어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너 걱정했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 다섯 걸음만 걸을 수 있는 신발은 안 골라서 다행이야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 주로 그게 진짜라는 걸 느꼈어, 어젯밤에 얘기한 것처럼.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하지만 난 여기서 네가 취소하라고 했으면 좋겠다고 생각하고 있진 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 아무것도 느끼지 않았던 척하지 않고 그렇게 말해줘서 기뻐.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 즐거운 시간을 보냈다고 하니 좋네. 네가 본래의 네 모습처럼 들려서 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 여전히 나야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아. 내일 너를 만나는 게 기대돼.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 어때? 오늘은 네가 기대한 대로였어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 뭘 기대해야 할지 정확히 몰랐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 가끔은 내 실수에서 배워.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 가서 기뻤고, 내가 하던 게임보다 네 메시지를 더 기다리고 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 꽤 대단한 성과야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말 큰 성과지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 주로 네가 돌아왔을 때의 목소리가 좋았어. 네가 내가 듣고 싶어 할 것만 말하는 게 아니었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니. 좋은 오후를 보냈으니까 너와 이야기하고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 나를 행복하게 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 다시 너를 안고 싶게 만들고 있어 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 다른 얘기하기 전에, 오늘 아침에 네가 한 말이 정말 도움이 됐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 카페에서 찍은 사진 어땠어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋았어. 그 순간에 나를 포함하고 싶어 해줘서 고마워.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그거 말인데, 먼저 그한테 물어봤어. 사진 찍고 너한테 보내도 되는지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 알아, 너가 말해줬잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 전 휴대폰을 치웠어. 데이트 내내 다음 메시지를 보내려고 애쓰고 싶지 않았거든.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴 필요 없었어. 네가 진짜로 나누고 싶었던 걸 듣는 게 좋았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 스스로 선택하는 거에 대해?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나중에 내 말로 그걸 전할 수 있어서 기뻐.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 내가 원했던 거야. 네가 나를 위해 데이트 내내 뭘 모으지 않아도 됐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 너는 집에 가는 길에 있는 여자친구의 사진도 얻었잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 부분이 특히 좋았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너의 아주 평범한 특권은 그대로야 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리가 작별 인사를 할 때까지 휴대폰을 두고 있는 게 도움이 됐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너와 이야기하고 싶지 않아서가 아니야. 그냥 동시에 두 개의 대화에 끼어들고 싶지 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이제 제대로 이야기할 수 있어서 더 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 그래. 진짜로 즐길 시간이 있을 때 네 관심을 받고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 몇몇 순간을 나만의 것으로 간직해도 오늘 밤 너와 멀어질 필요는 없다는 게 좋아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 거리가 생기길 원하지 않았어. 네가 너 자신일 수 있는 공간을 원했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이제 그걸 실제로 경험하니까 느낌이 다르네.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 처음엔 내가 다음에 뭘 하든 네가 어떻게 생각할지 고민했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 집에 잘 갔어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내일 점심 후에 시간 있어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 영화와 비현실적인 양의 파스타를 가진 여자를 위해? 응.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 너를 보고 싶어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 용기를 가져갈게, 그리고 네가 내 영화 선택에 동의한 걸 잊었다고 가장할 수는 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 기억해. 심지어 소파에 자리를 만들었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나를 위한 거야, 아니면 파스타를 위한 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 도착하면 우선순위에 대해 이야기해보자

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 틀린 대답이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너를 위해서. 파스타는 의자에 앉을 수 있어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 훨씬 나아졌어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그때 너가 집에서 내가 지시를 따르길 기다리고 있지 않다는 걸 기억했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 오늘 너 옆에 앉는 게 그리웠어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내일 그거 마음껏 먹어도 돼

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴 생각이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지금 피곤해?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 조금 피곤해. 힘든 건 아니고, 그냥 화면 보는 걸 그만두고 싶어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 여기서 자버리기 전에 침대에 들어가게 해줘

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7분 후

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 도착했어. 심지어 핸드폰도 충전하는 걸 잊지 않았어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정리 잘하는 여자네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐이야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 난 아니었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이건 내가 내려놓기 전에 너를 위해서야

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 거기 있었으면 좋겠어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내일이야. 그럼 영화에 대한 내 멋진 해설도 직접 들을 수 있어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 방문에 포함돼?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 꺼질 수 없어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴 생각 없었어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잘 자, 잘생긴 남자야 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잘 자, 예쁜 아가씨. 좋은 하루 보냈다니 기뻐

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도! 너를 만나는 게 너무 기대돼.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너에게 바로 질문하지 않고 뭔가를 원하는 게 좋았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 네가 가졌으면 했던 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 네가 괜찮다고 해서 더 나아가려고 한 건 아니었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그것도 큰 차이가 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 내게서 제한이 없다는 건 네가 도달해야 할 목표가 아니었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇지. 이번엔 제대로 된 답을 찾으려 하지 않았어 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 모든 걸 내려놓고 방금 주머니에 넣은 핸드폰 찾느라 5분을 보냈어

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 카페 후에, 우리는 몇 블록 떨어진 작은 정원에 갔어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 데이트 중에 그는 어땠어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 여전히 그답더라. 우리가 주문도 하기 전에 컵에 대해 불평했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 뭐라고 말해야 할지 모르겠다고 할 때는 평소보다 더 솔직했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 그에게 짜증낼 거라고 기대하느라 너무 오랜 시간을 보냈다고 인정했어. 그래서 아직도 이 상황에 적응하려고 하고 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 상상할 수 있어요

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리 대화를 다 말해주진 않았어. 네가 허락한 것들의 목록을 따르지 않고 있다고만 말했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 산만했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 반응은 어땠어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 다시 놀랐어. 그리고 내가 원하는 걸 물어봐야 한다는 걸 이해했지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 이후로 상황에 대해 이야기하는 걸 멈추고 진짜 데이트를 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그걸 설명하는 걸 넘겼다니 기뻐.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 그래. 그가 나에 대한 작은 것들을 많이 기억하고 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 그가 농담으로 만들지 않고 좋은 말을 하는 걸 들을 수 있었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 그냥 두 번째 커피 마실 가치가 있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그걸 그에게 말하지 마. 그러면 모든 칭찬을 자랑하기 시작할 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 후 우리는 정원에 멈춰서, {{name:aiden}}가 나에게 키스했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 먼저 키스했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 조금

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 내가 뭐라고 말할지 결정하기도 전에.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 그를 살짝 밀었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 괜찮았어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응, 그냥 나를 놀라게 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 두 번째를 원했어. 그는 멈췄고, 그 다음에 너무 만족스러운 표정을 지었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 그럴 것 같아

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 내가 어차피 그를 키스할 거라고 생각했나 봐, 그래서 나보다 먼저 나가려고 했던 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 당연히 그는 자신이 옳다고 주장할 방법을 찾았지.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정확히 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 계속 나를 가지고 놀았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잃어버린 양말 찾았어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 내가 그를 키스해서 입을 다물게 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 네가 원해서 그런 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 짜증나게도, 그 두 가지가 동시에 일어났어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그를 입 다물게 한 건 효과가 있었어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 키스하는 동안은 그랬어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 다음에 누가 더 잘 키스하는지, 그가 더 잘하는지 아니면 네가 더 잘하는지 물어봤어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그게 진짜로 네게 물어본 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 그게 아주 중요한 질문인 것 같았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 그에게 모든 걸 경쟁으로 바꾼다고 말했어. 게임이든 수업이든, 이거도 마찬가지야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 그걸로 그가 멈춘 거야?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 소매 안에 있었어. 어떻게 거기 들어갔는지 아무도 모르겠어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 물론 아니지

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그래서 나는 지금은 그가 아직 많이 뒤쳐져 있다고 말했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 지금은?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아, 너도 그걸 시작하지 마.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 오늘 오후에 한 경쟁적인 바보와 함께 있었어. 오늘 밤에는 또 필요 없어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 내 우위를 즐기고 있는 거야.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 내 주장을 증명하고 있어 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 어떻게 반응했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 웃으면서 내가 그에게 도전을 준 것 같다고 했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 그게 도전이 아니라고 했는데, 그건 별로 중요하지 않았던 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너의 세탁기는 유머 감각이 좀 부족해.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그거 맞는 것 같아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 그런 행동을 알아차릴 거라는 걸 알았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 더 나쁘게 들리게 할 필요 없다는 거 알지?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니야. 그와 키스하는 게 좋았어, 비록 그가 그 이후에 좀 힘들었지만.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그걸 말해줘서 고마워.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 두 번째에는 놀라지도 않고, 내가 뭘 해야 할지 고민하지도 않았어. 그냥 하고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 후에 이상했어?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐 동안만 그랬어. 그 후에 다시 너무 많이 떠들어서 더 이상 고민하지 않게 됐어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리는 잠시 그늘에 앉아 있었어. 그가 모든 것에 대해 계속 언급하면 혼자 앉게 하겠다고 협박했어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 로맨스는 여전히 살아있어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 업데이트가 도움이 될 줄 알았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 같은 여자를 사랑하고 있어. 네가 선택한 걸 알지?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 다시 계획을 세우자고 했는데, 나는 아직 이 데이트 중인데 다음 데이트를 정하고 싶지 않았어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그건 이해가 가네

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그를 피하는 방법이 아니었어. 그냥 집에 가서 오늘을 좀 정리하고 싶었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 카페 후에 산책하러 갔다고 말했잖아.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 가고 싶어 했던 서점이 있어서 우리는 중고 서가를 둘러보게 되었어.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 책이 거기서 나온 거야?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아, 내일은 집에 좀 늦게 올 수도 있어

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 직장에서 몇 명이 저녁을 먹고 있어

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
Yeah, a few of us
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
All right, just let me know when you're back
I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 저녁 내내 핸드폰 확인할 필요 없어

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
A few things
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
Including blaming the controller?
That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이미 갈아입었어. 간단한 거 만들고, 많이 움직이지 않을 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
{{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}}가 여러 번 무시된 메시지 후 {{name:hailey}}를 침대에서 끌어냈다

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그런데 아직도 침대에 누워 있는 건 너잖아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
Don’t make me come up there

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 안녕 😊 오늘은 알람도 없고, 옷 입는 건 아침 먹고 나서 해도 될 것 같아 ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 아침 내내 지키고 있었어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 집을 나가기 전에

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아, 음식이랑 영화, 그리고 이번엔 딱 맞는 뚜껑도 가져왔어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 작은 탐험을 준비한 것 같네

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 냅킨을 충분히 가지고 있을 거라고 믿을 수 없어서야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너만 오면 돼. 나머지는 조정 가능해

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 덕분에 불평하는 걸 멈췄어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이 조용함이 계속되는 동안 즐길게

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오래는 못 갈걸. 지금 가는 중이야 ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 앞으로 20분 동안은 완전 그렇게 할 거야 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 후에 빵집 옆 작은 시장에 갈 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 필요한 거 사러 가는 거야?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이번에는 같은 길로 나가지 않고 집을 나가야 해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 나중에 너랑 같이 먹을 맛있는 것도 필요해 ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 파스타가 맛있는 거라고 생각했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 맞아. 하지만 파스타는 디저트로는 안 돼, 네가 아무리 칭찬해도.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내 오후 계획이 날아갔네.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 내가 고른 영화도 볼 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 기억해. 나는 신비로운 정전 같은 건 준비하지 않았어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 듣기엔 의심스러운 휴일 같아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 안 돼. 내가 네가 아직 결말을 말하지 않은 걸 드디어 찾았거든.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그런 적이 있었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 형이 말도 하기 전에 수상해 보였다고 했잖아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그는 실내에서 장갑을 끼고 있었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그는 설거지를 하고 있었어 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럴듯한 변장이지.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘은 네 탐정 놀이를 혼자 해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 맞아 😌 오늘 아침은 일도 없고, 어디로도 급하게 가는 거 없어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 메시지 사이의 정적이 뭘 의미하는지 궁금해하는 대신 네 얼굴을 실제로 보는 게 기대돼.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 정적은 주로 내가 적절한 말을 찾으려고 했던 거였어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 알아. 오늘은 정상적인 사람처럼 입에 음식이 가득해도 말할 수 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 내가 할 수 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 난 너와 함께 즐거운 오후를 보내고 싶어, 또 다른 진지한 회의는 아니고.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어젯밤 너가 너무 기뻐 보였어서 그 표정을 보려고 거의 너에게 갔었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 오후에 그걸 살펴볼 수 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 창문을 열고, 커피가 아직 뜨거울 때 마시고 있어 ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럴 생각이야. 아주 가까이서.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너무 자랑스러워 보이지 않으려고 노력할게.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 정말 좋은 변화일 거야 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 후에 집에 있을 거야?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아직 저녁 계획은 정하지 않았어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그게 오늘 내가 좋아하는 부분이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 낯선 경험이네.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}가 아케이드 간판 사진을 보내줬어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 또 다른 곳에서 지는 것에 대해 불평할 곳을 찾았나?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그냥 내 휴일을 위해 도움이 되는 제안을 한 것 같아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그게 그의 수법이야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 그에게 오늘 오후에 너랑 이미 약속이 있다고 말했어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그가 너에게 에어 하키 테이블이 중립 지역인지 물어보라고 했어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그가 지기 전까지만 그렇지. 그때부터 테이블이 음모에 연루돼

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나중에 갈 수도 있어. 그걸 설명하려고 애쓰는 모습 보는 게 재밌을 것 같아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이미 이긴 후에 3판 중 1판을 수락하지 마

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 정말 그래. 이게 익숙해지면 같이 사는 게 힘들어질 수도 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 적어둘게 😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어제 그 남자가 우리가 봤던 책에 대해 메시지를 보냈어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 가게에서 본 그거?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응. 첫 페이지가 집에 가서 볼 가치가 있었나 봐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 뒷표지만 읽었으니까, 그에게 아직 자만하지 말라고 했어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 책 클럽의 유망한 시작이네

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 주로 우리가 계속 이야기하고 싶다는 걸 피하는 새로운 방법을 찾는 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그걸 눈치챘구나

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럴 수도 있어?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나중에는 좀 더 직접적으로 말할 수도 있어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 지금은 그에게 너랑 오후를 보낼 거라고 말했어. 오늘 저녁에 이야기하자 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 내 훌륭한 영화 해설을 전화기랑 나누고 싶지 않아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내 가방에 두고 갈게. 코멘터리용이야, 너를 위한 건 아니고.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 맞아, 내가 원하는 걸 다 팔기 전에 진짜 옷을 입어야겠어 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 뭘 원하는지도 아직 결정 안 했잖아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그래서 선택지가 필요해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 조사를 기다릴게.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 도착하기 전에 간식 다 먹지 마!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 조심해, 아직 너에게 뭘 가져갈지 고민 중이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그날 아침에

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 작은 업데이트: 빵집 아줌마가 나를 기억하더라.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 좋게 들리네

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 항상 빵만 산다고 말하는 걸 기억하더라.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너의 방어에는 별로 좋지 않네.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그녀는 이미 더 큰 가방을 집으려고 했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 분명히 빵만은 아니야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 거기 빵은 있어. 어딘가에.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 우리 둘을 위해 사과 페이스트리 두 개 샀고, 집에 가는 길이 아깝지 않게 다른 것도 충분히 샀어 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 행복해 보여

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 나는. 다음에 어디에 가야 할지 계산도 안 하고 꽃 구경하는 데 10분을 보냈어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 하나도 안 샀어. 그냥 그곳에 있는 게 좋았어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 우린 그런 날을 더 많이 가져야 해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 그래야 해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나는 용기를 가지러 집에 갈 거고, 그러고 나서 점심 먹고 약속한 대로 올게.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 1시 반 괜찮아?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 완벽해

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 음료수는 냉장고에 넣을게.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 소파 내 쪽은 비워둬줘

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너는 이미 아무것도 안 하는 것에 대해 마음을 정리한 것 같아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 헬스장 가는 거야, 아니면 코치와의 데이트?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 다른 야한 옷 찾고 있지 않겠지?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 안녕 ❤️ 길을 조금 내려갔는데 벌써 네 영화 이론이 말이 안 되는 이유를 또 생각해냈어 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
The photo booth is tempting 😊
To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니, 네가 얼굴 찡그리지 않고 네 장 찍을 수 있는지 보고 싶어서.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 몇 분 후, 포토 부스 안에서

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 적어도 하나는 망칠 거라는 거 알지?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럼 가까이 와. 최대한의 이점을 얻어야 해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
You brought most of it with you
Too late. The countdown has started
Subjects enter the photo booth
Series of personal photographs captured
I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그녀가 저녁을 즐겼으면 좋겠다. 둘이 얼마나 가까워지고 있는지 궁금하다는 것도 인정할 수 있다.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
Photo Booth Strip I
Photo Booth Strip II
You pulled a face in the first one
And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 너는 모든 사진에서 웃었으니까, 난 여전히 내가 이겼다고 생각해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이기는 게 그렇게 되는 건 아니야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 말한 건 우리가 대화를 멈추고 그냥 함께 앉아 있었던 그 부분이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이거 하고도 여전히 핀볼 고를 거야?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 그리고 난 여전히 저녁 내내 점수 세는 건 안 할 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너의 점수는 너 혼자만 알고 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 거리가 이렇게 조용할 수 있다는 걸 잊고 있었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내 귀는 아직 안에서 레이싱 게임 하고 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너의 자존심도 거기 어딘가에 있을 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 거기 가기 전까지 네가 내 옆에 있는 게 얼마나 그리웠는지 몰랐어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 그걸 절대 잊지 않을 거라는 걸 알면서도.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
Shall I walk with you for a bit?
Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
That sounds sensible
That was almost an invitation
Almost?
Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 차 한 잔 하러 올래? 네가 큰 공연 전에 먹기를 거부했던 페이스트리도 아직 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나도 그게 좋았어. 네 팔꿈치가 내 갈비뼈를 찾았을 때도 말이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 내 두 번째 컨트롤러 어디에 있는지 묻지 마

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그것에 대해선 언급도 안 할 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 집에 가서 소파를 내 것으로 만들 거야 잠깐 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 나는 괜찮아. 책도 있고, 나보다 더 읽은 사람이 있으니까

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 네 집을 떠난 이후로 작은 메시지를 주고받고 있어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 내가 너를 만난 걸 기억하고 내가 자유롭다고 말할 때까지 기다렸어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 쿠션을 너무 많이 차지하고 있었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 그가 중요한 쿠션 논쟁을 방해하는 것에 대해 반대할 생각이었어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 여러 사진 없이는 아무도 이해하지 못했을 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
Don't encourage me
BACK AT HOME
Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 책에서 내 자리를 찾았어. 가게에서 넣어준 책갈피가 그대로야 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 읽는 것보다 대화로 더 많은 진전을 이뤘어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 둘 다 할 수 있는 척하지 말고 제대로 대답할 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응 ❤️ 이 사진은 너를 위해서야, 참고로. 그는 부끄러운 책갈피 이야기할 자격이 없어 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
An Answer in Pictures
I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 좋아할 만한 사진 두 장 있어. 그도 너에게 그의 사진을 보여줘도 괜찮다고 했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
Yes. This is the smile he asked for
Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 착하게 굴어. 이번엔 진짜 남은 음식을 남겨놨어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 이건 그가 주방에서 찍은 사진이야. 내가 전달하는 거고, 카메라 솜씨는 주장하지 않을게 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 앞치마는 그의 자격을 증명하려고 한 건가?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 저녁은 카메라를 위해 미소를 지을 수 없었던 모양이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그랬어. 내가 모른 척하기 전에 웃었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 그걸 먼저 알아볼 거라는 걸 알았어 ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 나한테 말할 시간이 두 시간이었잖아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 집에 용기를 두고 나서 {{name:aiden}} 만나러 갈 거야 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 그가 너의 전문가 조언을 낭비하기엔 아깝다고 했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 그 중 절반도 모르고 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그는 이미 기계 중 하나가 동전을 먹는다고 경고했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 유용하네. 네가 도착하기 전에 준비된 변명이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너가 모두를 비난하는 동안 나는 그걸 보느라 바빴어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그를 다시 보고 싶었고, 뭔가 하는 게 또 조심스러운 커피 대화보다 나아 보였어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 즐기고 와. 내가 또 설명할 필요 없어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 소파에 있는 탐정한테서 충분히 설명 들었어 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 모든 게임을 고르게 하지 마.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 방금 도착해서 경주 게임기를 가리켰어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
I was right about one person
I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
You won't need it
INSIDE THE ARCADE
You came prepared
For what?
Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 실용적인 신발이네. 이건 이길 준비가 된 사람의 신발이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 오늘 아침 시장을 돌아다닌 사람 같아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
A consolation prize already?
A pastry. I can still eat it myself
After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 일곱 명을 다 비난한 후에

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
Thank you. That was nice of you
There. See how little effort that took?
Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 오늘 밤 모든 문장을 감독할 거야?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
That's most of my material
You'll have to improvise
AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
That first point didn't count
Thorough detective work
The machine disagrees
You hit it before I was ready
You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너는 이게 얼마나 쉬울지 설명하고 있었잖아.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
You said you'd go easy on me
And clearly that was a mistake
So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그러니까 내가 이겼다는 걸 인정하는 거야?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 두 번째 게임을 할 여지가 있다는 건 인정해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니. 네가 첫 번째 기계를 골랐잖아. 나는 다음 걸 고를 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
{{name:lena}} wins the first round
HAK//NOTICE
And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그런데 네 페이스트리 마지막 한 입을 훔치는 걸 못 알아챘네

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
{{name:player}} put you up to this
He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 말했어, 네가 지면 또 한 판 하자고 할 거라고.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
About knowing you too well?
About coaching the opposition
I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너희 둘이 도와주지 않아도 퍽을 쳐낼 수 있었어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 미안, 다시 말해줄래? 기계 소음 때문에 잘 못 들었어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
I noticed. I let you have it
I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐 감상할 시간이 필요할 것 같아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
You really do count everything
Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너랑 사진 찍어도 될까? 그에게 보내고 싶어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 최소한 패배한 모습은 덜 보이게 해줘

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 너무 늦었어. 그 표정이 내가 원하는 거야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 사진 찍는 걸 동의했어. 그 표정은 완전히 그의 작품이야

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 나한테 경고한 걸 너 탓하고 있어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그에게 그의 변명 듣는 걸 그만두고 즐기고 있다고 전해줘

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
Thank you for this afternoon ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 너가 그녀를 다치게 하지 않을 거란 걸 알아
그 말이 정말 큰 의미가 있어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
All of this… in front of you
I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
She wants cardio more than anything 😌
I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 우리가 나갈 때 탈의실에서 뭔가 있었어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 그녀는 세션을 좀 더 이어가고 싶어 했어

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 이런 대화를 {{name:hailey}}랑 나누게 될 줄은 몰랐어 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 너희 둘이 서로 좋아하는 거 알아

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 안녕 😊 너에게 용기 뚜껑을 빌려야 해. 어떻게든 그걸 집에 가져왔어 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 너는 몰라. 거의 청력이 돌아왔어. 내 다른 부분들은 덜 차분해.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 나는 ❤️ 잠시 전화는 두고 있을 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
LATER THAT NIGHT
If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 이렇게 더 있으면 내가 나가려고 했던 걸 잊어버릴 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
Your shirt has ridden up
I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 나도 봤어. 거기 손 두고 있어도 돼.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 네가 먼저 일어나는 게 너무 어렵게 만들고 있어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그럼 나에게 한 번 더 키스하고 일어나. 오늘 밤은 너를 침대에 데려가지 않을 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 너도 생각하고 있었잖아. 나도 그랬어. 그래서 지금 말하는 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그의 손은 그녀의 허리에, 그녀의 손은 그의 셔츠 밑에.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 빠르게 진행되고 있다. 무엇이 편하고 괜찮은지 계속 솔직하게 이야기했으면 좋겠다.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
I liked tonight
The quieter part too?
A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 특히 그 부분. 너의 입, 너의 손. 모든 게.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 재치 있는 마지막 멘트를 하려고 하지 않아도 돼.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
You can keep that one
Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
I will
And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그리고 페이스트리 박스도 가져가. 여기 두면 내가 나머지 다 먹게 될 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
Somehow I think you'll cope
AFTER HE LEAVES
{{name:player}}?
He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그는 집에 갔어. 우리는 계획보다 훨씬 더 오랫동안 소파에 있었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 정말. 우리는 이야기하고 가까이 앉았고, 그 후에 내가 그를 끌어당겼어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그의 손은 내 상의 아래에 있었고, 내 손은 그의 셔츠 아래에 있었어. 우리는 더 이상 진행하지 않겠다고 말해야 할 때까지 키스했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 드디어 그가 너보다 잘하고 있는지 묻는 걸 멈췄어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 경쟁하지 않겠다고 하면서 경쟁으로 만들지 마 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 오늘 밤은 뭔가 달랐어. 우리가 뭘 해야 할지 고민하는 느낌이 덜했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 응. 실수로 그의 용기 뚜껑을 가져왔어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그의 손이 내 몸에 닿기를 원했어, 그래서 내가 그렇게 했어. 또 다른 말이 필요 없었어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 응, 조금 부끄럽고, 너와 함께한 오늘 오후가 정말 좋았어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
You sound pleased
I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 응, 기분이 좋게 피곤해, 아직도 좀 따뜻하고, 하루 종일 시계만 보지 않아서 정말 기뻐.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 너가 기억하고 싶은 세부사항은 간직해. 너가 즐거웠다니 나도 기뻐.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 고마워. 자기 전에 너와 몇 분 더 이야기하고 싶어 ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
LATER THAT NIGHT
A Reason to Smile
I finally put the app down 😌
Did you manage to read any of the book?
Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 조금 읽었어. 어제 얘기한 후엔 거의 못 읽었고, 사진 얘기한 후엔 더더욱.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그가 서점에서 나가기 싫어서 핑계를 찾고 있다고 했어. 그리고 나를 제대로 안고 싶다고.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그리고 너는 머무를 이유를 생각하고 있었던 거지.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그가 내 숟가락을 가지고 있어. 협상 중이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 정확해. 그 오해는 해결된 것 같아 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 오늘 밤 메시지가 훨씬 덜 조심스러워졌어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 책 얘기만 한다고 계속 속일 필요는 없었지?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 아니. 그에게 다시 만나고 싶다고 했어. 단순히 이야기하는 것만이 아니라.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그리고 서로 몇 장의 사진을 더 보냈어. 그 후엔 좀 덜 순수한 사진도.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그가 이 두 장은 너에게 보여줘도 된다고 했어. 나중 사진들은 그와 나만의 비밀이야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그건 보통 네가 아무것도 안 한 척할 때의 미소야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그도 알아챘어. 나한텐 정말 불편했지. 스트랩이 내 상황을 도와주지 않았어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그리고 이건 그가 찍어서 다시 보낸 거야.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 둘 다 대화가 즐거운 것 같아 보이네.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 그랬어. 그 이후로 둘 다 많이 읽지 않았어. 마지막 사진은 나 혼자 간직했어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 책은 회복할 거야. 나도 내일 전에 회복할 수 있을지 모르겠어.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: I know, thank you for caring so much

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I might have way too much time to do nothing

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Don’t worry as soon as I finish work and study I’ll keep you company maybe so much that you’ll want to be left alone 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 걱정하지 마, 내가 일과 공부를 마치면 너와 함께할게, 아마 너무 많이 함께해서 혼자 있고 싶어질 수도 있어 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Impossible for me to get tired of you

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 너 이 자식, 나는 절대 코를 골지 않아 😤

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Of course of course my lady
No more pics for you you will learn to respect your wife 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 더 이상 사진은 없어, 너는 아내를 존중하는 법을 배워야 해 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I’m just having fun with you and it makes me really happy
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 나는 너와 함께 노는 게 정말 즐거워서 정말 행복해.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: And I’m really happy to see you having fun, even if it’s by teasing me 🙂
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 그리고 네가 나를 괴롭히면서도 즐거워하는 모습을 보니 정말 기뻐 🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: See you when you finish work, love you

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s in two days, it’s quite soon
I wanted more time to stay with you during recovery
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 회복하는 동안 너와 함께할 시간이 더 필요했어.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve already done more than enough
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 너는 이미 충분히 많은 일을 해냈어.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s not how I see it
I’ll organize things differently so you won’t be alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 다르게 정리할게, 그래서 너는 혼자가 아닐 거야.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I don’t want you exhausting yourself because of me
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 나는 네가 나 때문에 지치길 원하지 않아.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: Thanks a lot, again, and I’m sorry I can’t help you right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 정말 고마워요, 다시 한 번, 지금 도와드릴 수 없어서 죄송해요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve done more than enough before
My turn to take care of things here
And {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} are here too, they will help
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 그리고 {{name:hailey}}와 {{name:mason}}도 여기 있어, 그들이 도와줄 거야.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: It means I’ll have to go back to work sooner than planned
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 그것은 내가 계획보다 더 빨리 일하러 돌아가야 한다는 뜻이야.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I guess they take anyone now

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 훈련 중에 한 소녀를 내려줬더니 그녀가 조금 울었어요 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: If you’re making food later I’m stealing some 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 나중에 음식을 만들면 좀 훔칠 거야 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Or I’m pulling up and screaming outside your door 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 아니면 내가 너의 문 밖에서 소리 지르며 나타날 거야 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: {{name:mason}}에게 나를 데리러 오고 럭비로 데려가라고 설득해줘.

Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 하지만 항상 이렇게 차가울 필요는 없어

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
