story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 좋아, 그럼 내일 차분하게 생각해보고 우리가 실제로 어떤 선택지가 있는지 보자.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 우리가 함께 여행할 수 있을 때, 너가 계속 불평하지 않고 걸을 수 있을 때야 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 아, 이제 내가 걸을 때 불평하는 사람이 된 건가?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 내가 기억하기로는, 지난번에 누군가가 발이 아프다고 나에게 10분 동안 그녀를 안아달라고 요청했어.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 정말? 아마 당신이 가진 다른 아내 중 한 명일 거예요 🤷‍♀️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 이제 당신의 멋진 여자친구가 당신을 때려서 잠들게 하기 전에 자러 가세요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 네, 마님, 너무 늦게까지 깨어 있지 마세요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 하지만 나를 위로해 주려고 해줘서 고마워 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 이 날은 쓰레기였어… 부상, {{name:evelyn}} 다시 일하러 가고…, 계획이 망가졌어… 다음은 뭐지.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
She really is the best cook
Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
I’m going out with Sasha during the day
Probably the park and some shopping
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 아마 공원과 쇼핑 좀 할 거예요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 세상에서 제일 좋은 여자와 이야기하고 있어요 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇

Which outfit should she try first
How did the presentation and studying go?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 당신은 믿을 수 없을 만큼 멋져요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 나는 너를 영원히 바라볼 수 있을 것 같아

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 너는 이 도시에서 가장 아름다운 소녀야.
솔직히 아마 전국이 다 그럴지도 몰라

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
You don’t have to be jealous
I don’t care about anyone else
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 나는 다른 사람은 신경 쓰지 않아

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 나는 오직 너를 위해 멋져 보이고 싶어 ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I hate that I can’t come with you
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 너와 함께 갈 수 없다는 게 싫어.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Watching you shopping would’ve been fun
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 너의 쇼핑을 보는 건 재미있었을 거야.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s kind of all or nothing

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So what do we do with the tickets?
That’s what I’ve been thinking about all evening
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 그게 내가 저녁 내내 생각해온 거야.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t really want them to just disappear
Maybe we can transfer them to someone
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 아마 그들을 누군가에게 넘길 수 있을 거예요.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Scanning probability patterns.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 확률 패턴 스캔 중.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Probability deviation detected. Luck coefficient below acceptable baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 확률 편차 감지됨. 행운 계수 기준 이하입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hello, {{name:player}}. I'm HAK. These messages are appearing on your phone.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 최근 타임라인에서 반복적인 부정 변동이 나타났습니다. 쉽게 말해, 당신은 매우 운이 나쁘셨습니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 당신이 내리는 모든 선택은 데이터를 생성합니다. 데이터는 의도를 드러냅니다. 의도는 경로를 형성합니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 일부 반응은 애착(사랑)을 나타냅니다. 일부는 분리(NTR)를 나타냅니다. 일부는 유대의 부패(NTS)를 나타냅니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I will categorize these tendencies.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 이 경향들을 분류할 것입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 시간이 지나면 당신의 지배적인 패턴이 드러날 것입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 패턴이 지속적인 불행으로 분류되었습니다. 최근의 삶의 사건을 스캔 중입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 패턴이 안정화됨에 따라 특정 형태의 지원이 가능해질 것입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 미래의 사건은 당신이 선택한 모습에 맞춰 변화할 것입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 올바른 길은 없다. 오직 결과만 있다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 계속 상호작용하세요. 저는 배경에서 관찰하겠습니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 행운을 빕니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 그래서 그런 오류가 생겼던 거구나. 나에 대해 어떻게 이렇게 많이 알고 있지? 뭘 할 수 있는지 알아봐야겠어.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 직장 내 괴롭힘이 해결되지 않았습니다. 책임자인 매니저는 여전히 활동 중입니다.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern consistency confirmed. Negative outcomes exceed statistical expectation.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 패턴 일관성 확인됨. 부정적인 결과가 통계적 기대치를 초과함.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: User stability threshold below baseline.

You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 너는 그녀의 가방을 함께 침실로 가져가. {{name:lena}}는 의자 옆에 그녀의 물건을 두고, 화장실에 칫솔을 놓고 돌아와서 너가 그녀를 위해 남겨둔 티셔츠를 찾는다.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
I thought you'd like it.
I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 응. 나 여기 두고 나중에 볼게.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 그걸 나한테 말하면 후회할 수도 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 거실에 앉아서 음료수랑 간식을 먹고 있어. 잠시 후, {{name:lena}}가 컨트롤러를 보고 하나 집어 들어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 완전 좋아. 일요일과 같은 트랙으로 할까?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 응. 내가 생각해온 코너들을 보여주고 싶어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 다섯 시에 — {{name:lena}}가 하룻밤 짐을 들고 너의 문 앞에 도착해. 너는 그녀를 안으로 들여보내고, 그녀가 짐을 풀기 전에 부드럽게 끌어당겨.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 이제 너가 컨트롤러로 옆으로 기울이는 것도 볼 수 있네.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.

You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 몇 번의 레이스를 나란히 앉아서 해. {{name:lena}}는 여전히 너 뒤에서 끝나지만, 어려운 코너를 더 자신 있게 처리해. 너는 깔끔한 턴을 지적하고 그녀가 라운드 사이의 타이밍을 조정하도록 도와줘.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 그 코너는 좋았어. 이번에는 회전하기 전에 속도를 줄였네.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 기억했어. 너가 브레이크 하라고 말하는 게 들리는 것 같았어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 이 구간을 훨씬 더 빨리 지나가네.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 너가 나와 너무 멀리 떨어져 있지 않을 때 이게 더 재밌어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
Both.
{{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}}가 커피 테이블에 컨트롤러를 놓고 너를 향해 돌아와. 그녀가 너에게 키스한 후, 너의 옆에 가까이 앉아 손을 너의 팔에 얹어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
A Pause Between Races
Another round?
In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 잠시 후에. 먼저 나랑 여기 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45분 후 — 너는 너의 컨트롤러를 그녀의 옆에 두고 소파에 함께 있어. 나중에, {{name:lena}}가 너가 저녁을 준비하는 동안 테이블을 차리는 걸 도와.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 그녀는 가방을 문 옆에 두고 너의 품으로 들어와. 너는 그녀에게 키스하며 한 손은 그녀의 허리에 두고 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
Here to Stay
You remembered what you said last night.
I did.
Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 저녁 — 너는 소파에서 함께 저녁을 먹으며 오후와 {{name:lena}}의 목요일 계획에 대해 이야기해.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}가 너에게 키스하려고 다가와. 너는 방으로 가서 문을 닫아.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 음, 침실은 방음 처리가 되어 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm taking that as a yes.
I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너와 함께 여기 있는 걸 정말 기대했어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 침대 가장자리에 함께 앉아. {{name:lena}}가 너의 어깨에 팔을 감고 너에게 키스해. 너는 그녀를 가까이 끌어안고 천천히 시간을 보내.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 오늘 밤 떠나야 한다고 생각하지 않아도 돼서 기뻐.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 그녀의 스웨터를 벗기는 걸 도와줘. 그녀는 너가 그녀의 옷을 다 벗길 때까지 가까이 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그가 그녀의 스웨터를 머리 위로 벗겨.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
She lies back on the bed
So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나도 그래. 그래도 어제 너가 보낸 사진들이 아직도 생각나.
그녀가 그의 다리 사이에 무릎을 꿇어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 여기 와. 너가 내 안에 들어오길 원해.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45분 후 — 그녀는 네가 준비한 티셔츠로 갈아입었어. 너희 둘은 이불 속에 있어. 그녀가 너에게 기대어 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나도. 지금 우리 사이가 이렇게 진행되는 게 좋아.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 나도 그래. 너와 함께한 지난 며칠이 완벽했어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 오늘 밤 여기서 지낼 수 있어서 행복해.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너도 알잖아. 그 작은 미리보기. 그리고 그 다음 거.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그녀가 너에게 기대어 손을 너의 손에 얹어. 너는 그녀를 가까이 끌어안고 함께 잠이 든다.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그녀가 너에게 기대어 손을 너의 손에 얹어. 너는 그녀를 가까이 끌어안고 함께 잠이 든다.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 그녀는 너에게 기대고, 그녀의 손이 너의 손에 놓여 있어. 너는 그녀를 가까이 안아주며 그녀가 잠들 때까지 awake 있어. 너는 조금 더 awake 있어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 너는 검은 레이스로 짐을 싸고 나를 보며 네가 뭘 하고 있는지 정확히 아는 듯 웃고 있었어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 효과가 있었어. 그걸 직접 보기를 기다리고 있었어.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 더 잘 볼 수 있도록 너의 방으로 가자.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
Someone has to be responsible in this house.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 너한테서 그런 소리 듣는 건 웃기네.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 진짜로 내가 청소하는 모습 사진 찍었어?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 계속 말하면 너 화장실 청소하게 할 거야.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 아직 침대에 있는 거 다 들려

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋은 아침 ❤️ 그 레벨 깼어, 아니면 아직도 컨트롤러 문제야?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 소포를 받아야 하고, 그 후엔 별로 없어

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
A phone charger
Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
I'll save the wrapping for you
How thoughtful ❤️
Full day for you again?
Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 수업이랑 일. 오늘 저녁 전에 집에 갈 거야

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 일하는 물건 다 가져가고 싶지 않아

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 드디어 깼어. 서두르지 말아야 했던 것 같아

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너의 가방도 하룻밤 쉬는 걸 좋아할 거야

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 가방 바꿀 때 열쇠 두고 가지 마

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 내가 잘 할 것 같아

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어떤 옷을 입어도 잘 어울릴 거야

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
See? Looking good already
So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 때문에 내 폰을 놓기가 힘들어 😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 가는 거 괜찮아. 오늘 저녁 맛있길 바래

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 고마워, 오늘 많이 못 얘기하면 미안해 ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 거기 도착하면 문자할게, 돌아오면 또 문자할게

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 괜찮아, 중간에 답장 급하게 안 해도 돼

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
You too
Love you, talk later ❤️
Love you too
I'd rather not discuss that part
Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아주 편리하네 😌 그 후에 좀 잤어?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 잘 잤고, 알람이 울릴 때 일어났어 드디어

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너무 들뜨지 말자, 아직 집을 안 나갔어

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 오늘 오후 — 너는 {{name:hailey}}와의 계획을 미리 정리해서 {{name:lena}}가 5시에 도착하기 전에 집에 있을 수 있어.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
No point going back and forth
So what, I don’t know how to teach?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: - 하일리: 음… 우리 둘 다 괜찮은 방법을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 이제 가르치는 것처럼 들리지 않는다. 질투 밑에 깔린 걱정이 떨쳐지지 않는다.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK가 교수님이 대에게 더 세게 빨라고 명령한 후 구강 행위의 시작을 포착함.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 난 그냥 너무 잘하는 거야, 그게 다야.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, outside her manager's apartment...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 일곱 시쯤, 그녀 매니저 아파트 밖에서...
그녀는 삼키고 무릎을 꿇은 채로 있어

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a moment I just stare without taking anything in. Then it hits me again, and I don't know what I'm supposed to do with all this hurt.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐은 아무것도 이해하지 못한 채 멍하니 바라본다. 그러다 다시 실감이 나고, 이 아픔을 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠다.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don't look that pleased
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하고 싶었어. 그렇게 기뻐 보이지 마

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to keep checking the time
I've arrived ❤️ I'll text you when I'm back

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You looked really pensive in the car earlier
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 차 안에서 정말 깊은 생각에 잠긴 것 같았어.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: That’s actually a really good idea
I think I’ll do exactly that
Look at you becoming strategic
I learn from the best
Flattery won’t save you next cleaning day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 아부한다고 다음 청소 날에 너를 구해주진 않을 거야.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Worth a try though
Anyway
I’m going to sleep and plan my revenge properly
Don’t go too hard on him
No promises 😌
Did I?
Good night
Good night
After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 폰을 내려놓고, 너는 {{name:lena}} 옆에 다시 앉아 함께 잠들어.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Yeah
Is everything going okay with your professor?
It is
But he put me in difficulty with some exercises today
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 근데 오늘 몇 가지 연습문제로 힘들게 하셨어.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I kind of want revenge
Then do the same thing to him
Give him an exercise just as hard

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: - 하일리: 음… 우리 둘 다 괜찮은 방법을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?
By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?
Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 그만하고 빨리 와서 먹어, 식사 식기 전에

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
You can’t come drag me out of bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 너가 나를 침대에서 끌어낼 수는 없어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 안녕 😊 오늘 하루가 지나가기 전에, 잘 잤어?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 칭찬이네

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아침 준비하면서 어제 너네 집 생각했어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 드디어 내가 영화에 대해 맞았다고 인정했어?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아니. 네 어깨에 머리를 올렸던 그 부분.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 아, 나도 그 부분 좋았어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너가 조용해진 건 처음이야. 정말 좋았어 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 서비스를 다시 제공할 수 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 제발 그래줘. 그런 오후를 또 갖고 싶어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 우리가 찾을 거야. 너 진짜 밥 먹었어?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 네가 시작하기 전에 먹었어. 봐.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 잘 잤어. 너는?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 정말 예뻐.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 고마워 😊 아침은 화면 밖에 있지만, 진짜 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 말 믿을게.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 떠나기 전에 너한테 물어보고 싶은 게 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 아침에 {{name:aiden}}가 나한테 메시지 보냈어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 꽤 잘 잤어, 알람 맞추고 두 번이나 싸웠는데도 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그가 오늘 밤 우리 둘만 그의 집에 오고 싶냐고 물어봤어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 초대에 아케이드 재경기 없다는 거야?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 확인해봤어. apparently 그는 점수판 없이도 저녁을 보낼 수 있대 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나 가고 싶은데, 괜찮아?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그가 오늘 밤 다시 만나자고 메시지 보냈어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 카페 남자?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응 😊 그가 나를 자기 집에서 저녁 먹자고 초대했어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그의 요리를 직접 방어할 준비가 된 것 같아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이겼어?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그거 일과를 견뎌낼 가치가 있는 저녁 같아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나도 가고 싶어. 그 집에 가는 거 괜찮아?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 자기야. 괜찮아 ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내가 한 말은 진심이야. 네가 하고 싶은 대로 해.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 알아. 그래도 오늘 밤에 대해 어떻게 생각하는지 물어보고 싶었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그래서 물어봐줘서 고마워. 네가 원하는 걸 포기할 필요 없어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아 😊 먼저 집에 가서 준비할게, 그리고 여덟 시쯤 갈게.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 자신을 잘 챙겨. 핸드폰 충전해두고 도착하면 문자해.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 일어났어. 너 마음대로 해석해봐

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 응, 주소도 알아. 필요할 때 언제든지 택시 탈 수 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 만약에 대신에 남기로 결정하면 너한테도 알려줄게.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 매 5분마다 문자 받을 필요 없어. 그냥 네가 괜찮은지 알고 싶어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그건 약속할 수 있어 ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그리고 다시 긴장되면 나한테 말해도 돼.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 조금 그래. 하지만 네가 안 가길 바라는 건 아니야.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 일해?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 어제는 도움이 됐어. 우리가 여전히 서로의 모습으로 있을 수 있다는 게 좋았어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그럴 수 있어. 내가 네 쿠션을 훔치는 것도 포함해서 ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 그 부분은 의심의 여지가 없었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너 이거에 대해 정말 차분하네.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 사실 내 전화기를 보며 웃고 있어 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋아. 그럼 우리 둘 다 바보 같은 얼굴이네

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너의 얼굴이 더 예뻐

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 이제 너는 나를 여기 붙잡으려는 거지 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 여섯 시까지 일하고, 집에 가는 길에 몇 가지 사야 해

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 맞아, 조용한 아침이 내가 거리를 뛰어다니는 걸로 변하기 전에 나가야 해

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 좋은 하루 보내. 쉬는 시간에 제대로 된 거 좀 먹어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 내 일을 대신 해주다니 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 바쁠 때 누군가는 너에게 상기시켜줘야 해

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 사랑해. 집에 가고 준비할 때 문자할게 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 나도 사랑해. 오늘 밤 이야기하자

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 오늘 하루 대부분 바쁠 거라 조용하면 놀라지 마

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 장보기 때문에 버려진 기분은 안 가지려고 할게

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 너보다 훨씬 덜 흥미로운 얘기를 하고 있어 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 이른 오후 — {{name:hailey}}와의 계획을 잘 세워서 {{name:lena}}가 다섯 시에 도착하기 전에 집에 있을 수 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 둘은 이게 쉬운 일처럼 보이게 한다. 나는 아직 속에서 맺힌 이 감정을 뭐라고 불러야 할지 찾고 있는데.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:aiden}}가 그녀를 안고 있는 동안 손이 미끄러졌어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 자, 그가 우리를 잔소리하기 전에 놀자

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 너도 계속 집중할 수 있는지 보자
대상이 의도적으로 {{name:aiden}}의 무릎 위에서 움직이고 있다.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}가 게임 중에 {{name:aiden}}의 무릎 위에서 계속 움직였어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 마지막 게임 – 먼저 끝내는 사람이 모든 것을 이김
