story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 가서 기쁘고, 모든 걸 화면 뒤에 숨기지 않아서 기뻐

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 먼저 저녁을 먹으면서 이야기했어. 내가 결정했을 때, 그게 내가 원하는 거라는 걸 알았어. 그리고 내 침대에서 자고 싶다는 것도 알았어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그랬어. 저녁도 맛있었어, 혹시 네가 아직 걱정하고 있다면 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 계획은 유지해. 언젠가 우리도 쓸 수 있을 거야 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 행복해. 오늘 밤은 세부사항은 비밀로 할 거지만, 집에 왔다는 걸 알려주고 싶었어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 괜찮아. 그 이상은 말하지 않아도 돼.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 고마워 ❤️ 가기로 한 건 좋은 결정이었어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
Found it easily?
I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 답하기 전에 잠깐 시간이 필요했지만, 괜찮아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 우리가 실제로 여기 있으니 느낌이 다르네. 긴장 안 하는 척하기보다는 이렇게 말하는 게 낫겠어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니, 우리가 이야기하고 있어서 기뻐. 잠깐의 시간이 필요했어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응, 그럴게. 좋은 저녁 보냈다니 기뻐

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 네 메시지가 오는 걸 보는 게 좋았어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 그가 두 개의 접시를 들고 문을 열었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
I have my moments 🙂
You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇지. 내가 생각하는 것보다 더 자주 그래 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
I love you
I love you too ❤️
I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 내가 아침에 메시지 할게, 네가 내 숟가락을 차지할 계획 세우기 전에

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 절대 아니야. 내 소파 쪽도 마찬가지야 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 진짜 접시야. 나는 테이크아웃 박스에서 바로 먹을 준비를 하고 있었거든 😭.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 둘 다 안전해. 잘 자, 사랑아

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 그 모든 것에 다시 한 번 고마워

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 고마워하지 마. 우리 둘 다 원했잖아. 이렇게 함께 하고 있어서 기뻐 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
Good night ❤️
He’s making an effort, then
Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그런가 봐. 그가 접시를 놓는 동안 빠르게 사진 한 장 찍었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 안전하고, 실내에 있고, 곧 밥 먹을 거야 😊 내가 길을 잃었는지 궁금해하지 않아도 돼.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
Please accept my sympathy 😌
I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그럴게 ❤️ 이제 핸드폰 치울게. 나중에 얘기하자.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
Have I passed the inspection?
I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 도착했다고 했잖아. 네 집 리뷰 쓰는 게 아니었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아. 모든 게 쌓인 의자는 별 하나를 잃게 할 거야.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
Of course you did
He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 나에게 좋은 저녁 보내라고 했어. 너는 나에게 밥부터 줘야 해.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 집에 오는 길에 저녁을 샀어. 갑자기 요리를 배운 척은 안 해.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 조심해. 또 칭찬하면 여기 있는 걸 좋아하는 줄 알겠어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그렇지. 그걸 가지고 긴 연설을 할 필요는 없어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
Excellent decision
DURING DINNER
You’re watching my mouth
You’re taking too long. Open
Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그도 이렇게 먹여줘, 아니면 특별 서비스야?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 바빠서 커피가 식어버린 걸 자주 발견했어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그리고 이제 너의 엄지에 소스가 묻었어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 먹어. 그러면 더 유용한 곳에서 귀찮게 할 수 있어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 잠깐, 그게 포토 부스에서 찍은 사진이야?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 주머니에 넣어두는 것보다 거기서 더 잘 나왔어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 눈 감고 찍은 사진을 제일 앞에 두었네.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
I remember
But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하지만 내 목록에 있는 건 다 끝났고, 내 전화도 충전됐어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
No. Leave it there
You’ve gone quiet
I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그걸 네가 볼 수 있는 곳에 두었다니 좋아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 저녁이 좋았어. 사진을 간직하는 건 당연한 것 같았어.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 가끔은 하나 할 수 있어. 브리핑보다 나아?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
Here?
You know what I mean
You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 저녁 시간을 되찾아서 기쁜 것 같네

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
Was that the reward for a nice answer?
No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 아니. 그건 너를 키스하고 싶었기 때문이야.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 더 좋지. 그도 저녁 후에 그렇게 키스해?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 말 그만해. 앉아, 그리고 네 손은 내가 놓은 곳에 두고.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
Yes
ON THE SOFA
Two fingers?
Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 응. 천천히, 그 다음 덜 천천히.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 정말 그래. 신발 신기 전에 뭔가 보여줄게

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
I’m not answering that. Keep going
Under the Dress
There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
You’re close
I know. Don’t stop
That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 그 소리. 그도 그걸 느끼는 거야?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
HER TURN
You don’t have to—
I know. I want to
Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이게 내가 일부러 그한테 지는 부분이야?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 이제 너는 말 그만하고. 내 머리카락에 손을 대. 내가 말하지 않는 한 나를 떼어내지 마

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
I’m close
Good. Stay there
In Her Mouth
You didn’t have to swallow
I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 하고 싶었어. 그렇게 기뻐 보이지 마

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 자 😊 20분 이상 준비할 시간이 있었던 것처럼 보이게 했어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 공부에 이렇게 집중한 나한테 주는 보상이야 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
You really sent that to him?
How did the practice test go?
She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 여기서는 그녀가 자기 마음을 확신하는 것 같다. 그게 나한테 어떤 의미인지 나는 아직 알아 가는 중이다.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}}가 성공적인 모의 시험 후 보상으로 애널링구스를 해주고 있어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 조심해… 너무 빨리 끝내면 벌점 받을 거야

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 근데 주제를 더 깊이 파고들어야 해

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 그럼 난 그 모든 걸 더 깊이 파고드는 게 정말 기대돼 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 벌점 안 받은 거 아쉽지 않아?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 게임 세션 동안 너가 모든 걸 지켜본 부분이야 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: - 하일리: 음… 우리 둘 다 괜찮은 방법을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 제대로 인정하면 더 좋은 걸 보여줄게

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 내 친구가 떠날 때 이렇게 남겨놓고 갔어

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 내 보상을 찍은 사진을 보냈던 부분이야 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 그리고 그게 네가 좋아하는 미친 짓이야

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
I don’t know what you’re talking about
Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 아쉽네… 그걸 좋아했다면 너에게 줄 다른 서프라이즈가 있었거든
- 하일리: 음… 우리 둘 다 괜찮은 방법을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 드디어 인정했으니 너도 보상을 받을 거야

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 폰을 내려놓고, 너는 {{name:lena}} 옆에 다시 앉아 함께 잠들어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
Trying to wake up slowly
Of course you are 😏
I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 너는 절대 엄지를 쉬지 않는다고 맹세해.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 내 손가락이 너에게 문자 보내는 데 사용될 때 너는 행복하지?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
By the way…
About the tickets for our trip
I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 이제 그들과 무엇을 해야 할지 모르겠어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
Give them to someone who really needs a break
Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그들을 유지하고 {{name:aiden}}와 함께 가는 건 어때?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
Hey you 🙂
That's actually really kind of you 😊
You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 당신은 항상 올바른 일을 하려고 노력합니다.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 물론이지, 요즘 카르마 덕분에 내가 얼마나 운이 좋은지 봐 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 내가 너의 여자친구인 게 충분하지 않아?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그렇습니다! 저는 세상에서 가장 운 좋은 남자입니다 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
I swear
I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 나는 세상에서 가장 운 좋은 소녀야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 채소를 남자로 두는 건? 잘 모르겠네 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 너는 내가 채소를 얼마나 좋아하는지 알고 있지 😉

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're too sweet
With {{name:aiden}}?
Why?
He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그는 항상 그 섬에 가고 싶어 했고, 적어도 그는 두 다리가 있다.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그와 단둘이 가는 것은 별로 편할 것 같지 않아요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그가 내 친구이고 너의 가장 친한 친구라도, 이상하지 않아?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 하지만 나는 너희 둘을 믿고, 내가 때문에 여행을 놓치길 원하지 않아. 동시에 그는 그토록 원했던 섬 여행을 드디어 가게 될 거야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 너가 맞아, 내가 너무 생각하고 있어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그리고 한 달 이상 남았으니 생각할 시간이 있어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
You won't be jealous?
Of course I will
My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 내 가장 친한 친구가 우리가 준비한 휴가를 가고, 내 집에서 내 여자친구와 시간을 보내고 있어. 도대체 누가 질투하지 않을 수 있을까!

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그렇고, 당신이 나를 많이 걱정하고 있다는 게 달콤하게 보여요 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
That's called love
You're too much of a sweet talker
Only with you ❤️
You better 😌
Someone else?
That feels a little cold 😕
Sorry I didn't mean it that way
I'm good 😊
It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 당신은 나와 함께가 아니더라도 여행을 즐길 수 있도록 섬에 함께 가고 싶어하는 다른 사람을 찾아야 할 것 같아요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
You're upset?
No
I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 나는 네가 그런 말을 할 줄은 전혀 예상하지 못했어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 왜? 나쁜 의미로 한 말이 아니었어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 미안해, 아무것도 아닌 일로 큰 소동을 일으켰어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그냥 너와 함께 가지 못해서 슬퍼.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 하지만 다음 번에 내가 회복되면 우리는 함께 갈 거야 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
I hope so
Promise
Also
I’m coming over today
Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 사샤랑 잡았던 약속을 미뤄서 오늘은 너랑 하루 종일 보낼 수 있어 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 정말로 당신의 유일한 휴일에 이렇게까지 올 필요는 없어요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 나는 네가 그렇게 느끼길 원하지 않아.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
But I want to
I miss you
And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 그리고 네가 나를 막으려 해도 나는 어쨌든 올 거야 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
That really means a lot
See you in half an hour ❤️
5 MINUTES LATER
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 어젯밤 고른 옷은 날짜를 미룬 Sasha와의 외출 때 입으려고. 계획은 바뀌어도 좋은 선택은 그대로니까.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 어젯밤 고른 옷은 날짜를 미룬 Sasha와의 외출 때 입으려고. 계획은 바뀌어도 좋은 선택은 그대로니까.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And what are you doing?
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 어젯밤 고른 옷은 날짜를 미룬 Sasha와의 외출 때 입으려고. 계획은 바뀌어도 좋은 선택은 그대로니까.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 무슨 일이 생기면, 함께 해결책을 찾아보자.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
That’s good
You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 너무 오랫동안 혼자 있으면 안 돼.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 나중에 가서 네 방을 좀 환기시킬게.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It needs fresh air anyway
Thank you
You’re welcome
How is the leg this morning?
It’s okay. Still a little stiff
That’s normal
Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 그냥 용감해지려고 하지 말고 무리하지 마세요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
I’m alright
Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 일하러 돌아가는 것에 대한 스트레스가 나에게 영향을 미치기 시작했지만, 잘 해낼 거야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
Are you sure?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 나중에 한 판 편하게 하자, 랭크는 필요 없어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 원하는 경우 한 게임 후에. 의사 모드 명령

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
How are you actually doing this morning?
Head is still heavy from yesterday
I almost called because your replies were slow
If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 그 놈들이 다시 나타나면, 맹세코 그들의...를 부술 거야...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 그만둬, 나쁜 생각이야. 나는 차분함을 유지하려고 하고 있어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 모든 것이 공격인 것처럼 행동하지 마세요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 그냥 물어본 거야, 요즘 너가 더 자주 가는 걸 봤거든.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 나는 몸을 만들고 있고, 그건 노력과 시간이 필요해.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 다리 탓으로 모든 걸 돌리지 마세요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 지금은 어떤 운동도 할 수 없어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 하지만 내가 치유되면, 다시 몸을 회복할 거야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 그녀를 보면 점심 전에 돌려달라고 전해줘.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 어제 내 럭비 문제를 처리해줘서 고마워 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 내가 좀 귀찮게 한 것 같아 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 집에서 긴급 상황인 것처럼 들리게 만들었네.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: 나는 뭔가를 원할 때 정말 빠르다.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 그리고 나는 이제 조금 혼자서 움직일 수 있어요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 나는 네가 무리해서 다치지 않기를 바랄 뿐이야, 아무도 없으니까.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 모든 게 접혀 있어. {{name:lena}}가 가면 줄게.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 또한, 잊지 마세요. 내일 다시 일을 시작해요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 그래서 오후에는 내가 여기서 너를 도와줄 수 없어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
And send me the ones you took 😏
And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 그리고 만약 내가 그걸 했다면… 나는 그것들을 나 자신을 위해 간직할 거야 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 신경 안 써 😤 그들을 보내거나 너를 영원히 저주할 거야

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 오, 와우 😳 생각보다 더 많이 가져갔네

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 나는 못생겼어… 너는 그것들을 삭제해야 해

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 너는 내가 아는 가장 아름다운 소녀야 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 하지만 고마워… 그건 정말 큰 의미야 🥺

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Thank you for taking care of me today
Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 그만… 너무 많은 칭찬이야 😅, 하지만 나도 같은 기분이야

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿
In the shower? You never stop!
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 샤워 중이야? 너는 절대 멈추지 않아!

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: It was the best part of my week
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 내 주 중 가장 좋은 부분이었어
그리고 너는 점점 더 나아지고 있어

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 하지만 진지하게, 물, 음식이 필요하거나 다리가 과장되게 아프면 선반에 닿을 누군가가 필요하면 그냥 말해줘 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 그렇지 않으면 너에게 대가를 치르게 할 거야 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 그래서 그녀가 나간 동안 뭔가 필요하면, 그녀가 내 도움을 구걸해야 한다고 했어 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 그거 {{name:evelyn}}가 할 법한 말 같지 않네.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 그녀가 그렇게 말했어, 나는 그곳에 있었어 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 좋아, 좋아, 아마 그녀는 begging에 대해 아무 말도 하지 않았을 거야 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Wow, how quick of you to turn to the truth
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 와, 진실로 돌아가는 게 얼마나 빠른 거야

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Please appreciate how much personal growth this is 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 이게 얼마나 개인적인 성장인지 알아주셨으면 해요 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I need to pick an outfit for tomorrow
You look good in all of them
I don’t want to look out of place
I feel a little better now

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 너무 늦게까지 안 자는 게 좋겠어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Yes, see you and good luck
It’s been so long that I don’t even know what to wear anymore
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 너무 오랜만이라서 이제 뭘 입어야 할지 모르겠어.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Just tell me which one makes me look the least ugly
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 그냥 어떤 게 나를 가장 덜 못생기게 보이게 하는지 말해줘.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Show me and I’ll tell you which one looks best
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 보여줘, 그러면 어떤 게 제일 좋은지 말해줄게.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Talk nicely or I delete the photo 😈
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 잘 말해 아니면 사진 삭제할 거야 😈

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I feel clean and sleepy 😌
But I may have a little gift for you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 하지만 당신에게 작은 선물이 있을지도 몰라요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I need to see it
You don't even know what it is 😶
If it's from you it's already perfect

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 그리고 나는 바로 그 후에 바뀌었어.
아니면 정말 모든 것을 삭제할 거야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And don't show them to anyone
So now I can talk to you until I fall asleep 💤
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 이제 내가 잠들 때까지 너와 이야기할 수 있어 💤

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Emotional reassurance strengthens trust and intimacy
Playful ambiguity detected, tension may increase attraction
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 장난스러운 모호함이 감지되었습니다, 긴장이 매력을 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Critical moment detected, distancing may weaken emotional security
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 중대한 순간이 감지되었습니다. 거리가 감정적 안정성을 약화시킬 수 있습니다.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That's why I sent them to you
I loved having you here with me
When you're better we should go somewhere together
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 네가 나아지면 우리 함께 어딘가 가야 해.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We'll do it when you're completely healed
To make up for the missed trip
She has to go back to work tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 그녀는 내일 다시 일하러 가야 해.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 돈이 부족해지고 있고 그들이 그녀가 필요해요.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 그리고 네가 나아지면 그녀를 도와줄 수 있을 거야.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 나는 잠자기 전에 화장을 지우고 있어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 그들도 같은 기분일 거니까 걱정하지 마세요.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
Do you want me to bring it to you?
Are you going to take a shower this morning?
How are you feeling this morning?
The store doesn't want to take her back
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 가게는 그녀를 다시 받으려 하지 않는다.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 그래서 우리는 그녀의 엉망을 우리가 죽을 때까지 견뎌야 할 것이다.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 아니면 그녀를 원한 미친 사람을 찾아보자.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 오늘 아침은 조금 바쁠 것 같아요.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 직장에 복귀하기 위해 모든 것을 준비해야 해.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 내 가방, 내 옷, 그리고 몇 가지 문서

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
Just do what you have to do
Thank you for taking care of me
The same stress as a first day I guess
But I'm happy to see my colleagues!

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 느리게 해도 괜찮아, 아니면 네 보통 속도처럼 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 빨리 달리기 위해 훈련하는 게 좋겠어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Random warning 😇
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 내가 완전히 회복되면 나쁜 개구리들이 어떻게 되는지 볼 거야.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 위협은 내 공주 귀에 닿지 않아

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 수요일에 럭비 데려다 줄 {{name:aiden}} 아니면 {{name:mason}}가 필요해.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 나는 미리 계획하고 있어, 왜냐하면 성숙한 여성들이 그렇게 한다고 하더라고 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
How dare you say that 😤
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 어떻게 감히 그렇게 말할 수 있어 😤

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 그건 제대로 된 집사로서 행동하는 방법이 아니야 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want
They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 그들은 그가 대학에서 가장 잘생긴 남자라고 말해.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 우리는 그가 진짜로 어떤 사람인지 잘 알고 있어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: Still, it's true that he's handsome
But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 하지만 나는 너만 바라보니까 신경 쓰지 않아 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 너는 내가 뭘 하는지 언제부터 신경 쓰게 된 거야?

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 너가 화내지 않고 대화하는 게 정말 힘들어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 그냥 우리가 조금 덜 공격적으로 이야기할 수 있었으면 좋겠어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
It was in the living room
So I don't care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 그래서 나는 너에게 신경 쓰지 않아

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 집에 돌아왔을 때 너를 침대까지 안고 갔어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
Never mind the rest of the year
And thank you again for that
I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 나는 단지 우리가 뭔가 필요해서가 아닌 다른 이유로 이야기하고 싶어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that
I just want to know you better
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 나는 너를 더 잘 알고 싶어.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 가끔 너와 좋은 시간을 보내고 싶어

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 불만 이외의 다른 이유로 나에게 문자 보내는 게 너무 힘든가?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 나중에 랭크를 할 수 있어, 네가 괜찮다면.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 계속 웃어, 오늘 밤 30을 떨어뜨릴 거야.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 내가 너를 비웃기 전에, 그래 내 머리 이상해 보여

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 더 크게 말해줘, 나는 동기가 필요해!

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 재활에 집중하고 영웅이 되려고 하지 마세요.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening
I checked your medication and your food
Try not to stress too much okay
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 너무 스트레스 받지 않도록 해, 알겠지?

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 다시 돌아가는 게 아직 조금 이상하게 느껴져.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 당신은 침대에서 매우 슬픈 불만을 제기할 것 같은 사람처럼 보이네요 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 정말 늦으면 아주 나쁜 일이니, 서둘러 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 집에 가는 길에 쥐약 좀 사야겠다.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 내가 도착하기 전에 굶지 마세요, 쥐씨🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 너가 고장 나서 아무도 집에 없으니까

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 즉, 당신의 음식이 계획보다 조금 늦게 방으로 배달될 거예요 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 그렇게 말하면 마치 내가 불만을 제기할 것처럼 들리네.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 그런 다음 나는 바로 샤워하러 갔어 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So now you look unfairly pretty?
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 그래서 이제 너는 불공평하게 예쁘게 보이니?

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 내 눈으로 직접 확인해야 할 만큼 예쁘다.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 한 번 문자 보내주면 더 좋겠어

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry
But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 하지만 당신과 좀 더 이야기하고 싶어요.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 나는 여기 남아서 너와 이야기하고 싶어

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 가서 쉬어, 긴 하루를 보낸 후에 너에게 필요해.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 하지만 그건 사실이야, 그래서 나는 더 짜증나 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 나는 너를 걱정해서 그렇게 말하는 거야.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 나는 지금 내 꿈을 살고 있어.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그건 완전히 정상적인 거야, 결국 큰 변화니까

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 하지만 너는 잘 할 거라고 확신해

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 지금은 모든 게 합법적인지 확인하고 있어

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 보통 내일 모든 답을 알아야 해

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 모든 게 괜찮으면 그 이후에 시작할 수 있을 거야

And maybe a little nervous too
That is perfectly normal
We will take it one step at a time
Alright

Why are you asking?
Because I keep thinking about it
I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 나는 그렇게 똑똑하지도 않고 그런 경험도 많지 않아

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 그건 아니야, 너는 생각보다 훨씬 능력이 있어

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 이게 너에게 동기부여가 될 것 같아서 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I made steak and french fries

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 꿈의 몸매가 네 얼굴을 고쳐주진 않아.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 너가 나한테 모든 걸 지고 있어도 그 근육은 소용없을 거야.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 네가 어떤 상태인지, 어떤 부분이 필요한지 보고 싶대

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 그가 네가 얼마나 힘든지 알게 될 거야 😔

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: You're enjoying this way too much

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 좋아, 과외는 내일이고 오늘 밤은 파티야 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 이제 여자애들이랑 파티에 가려고. 잘 자, 코치님

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 시험 준비하는 학생들과 잘 지내는 방법을 알고 있어

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?

ui.auto.lucas_likes_planned_full_day_out.translation: 루카스는 계획된 하루 종일의 외출과 애정 어린 커플 역할 놀이를 좋아합니다. 그는 기대에 대해 직접적으로 이야기하며, 신체 접촉 전에 물어보는 것에 동의합니다.

ui.auto.lucas_likes_planned_full_day_out.source: Lucas likes planned full-day outings, good restaurants, and showing someone a polished version of the city.
ui.auto.lucas_likes_planned_full_day_out.translation: 루카스는 계획된 하루 종일의 외출, 좋은 레스토랑, 그리고 누군가에게 도시의 세련된 모습을 보여주는 것을 좋아합니다.

ui.auto.luxury_chaos_slow_camera_no_apol.source: Luxury chaos, slow camera, no apologies.
ui.auto.luxury_chaos_slow_camera_no_apol.translation: 사치스러운 혼란, 느린 카메라, 사과는 없다.

ui.auto.male_creator_account_subscribe_t.source: Male creator account. Subscribe to unlock the private route feed.
ui.auto.male_creator_account_subscribe_t.translation: 남성 제작자 계정. 개인 경로 피드를 잠금 해제하려면 구독하세요.

ui.auto.night_city_glow_and_after_hours_.source: Night city glow and after-hours confidence.

ui.auto.no_evidence_has_been_deposited_y.source: No evidence has been deposited yet.

ui.auto.no_playable_conversations_are_av.source: No playable conversations are available from this day.

ui.auto.noah_is_relaxed_and_attentive_he.source: Noah is relaxed and attentive. He prefers simple dates, clear boundaries, and someone who can make an ordinary afternoon feel special.
ui.auto.noah_is_relaxed_and_attentive_he.translation: 노아는 편안하고 주의 깊어. 그는 간단한 데이트와 명확한 경계를 선호하고, 평범한 오후를 특별하게 만들어줄 사람을 원해.

ui.auto.noah_is_relaxed_attentive_and_en.source: Noah is relaxed, attentive, and enjoys turning ordinary evenings into small adventures.
ui.auto.noah_is_relaxed_attentive_and_en.translation: 노아는 편안하고 주의 깊으며, 평범한 저녁을 작은 모험으로 바꾸는 걸 좋아해.

ui.auto.noah_sent_a_new_meetandgreet_upd.source: Noah sent a new MeetAndGreet update.

ui.auto.opens_the_patreon_code_prompt_to.source: Opens the Patreon code prompt to unlock premium content on this device.
ui.auto.opens_the_patreon_code_prompt_to.translation: 이 기기에서 프리미엄 콘텐츠를 잠금 해제하기 위한 Patreon 코드 프롬프트를 열어.

ui.auto.permanent_unlocks_live_outside_t.source: Permanent unlocks live outside the story timeline. They stay with the player through saves, reloads, and timeline shifts.
ui.auto.permanent_unlocks_live_outside_t.translation: 영구 잠금 해제는 스토리 타임라인 외부에 있어. 저장, 재로드, 타임라인 이동을 통해 플레이어와 함께 남아.

ui.auto.private_set_is_live_keep_up.1ixf.source: Private set is live. Keep up.

ui.auto.rain_outside_one_more_chapter_in.source: Rain outside. One more chapter inside.
ui.auto.rain_outside_one_more_chapter_in.translation: 밖에는 비. 안에서는 한 장 더.

ui.auto.replaying_from_here_rewinds_the_.source: Replaying from here rewinds the story back to that checkpoint. Gallery/global unlocks remain untouched.
ui.auto.replaying_from_here_rewinds_the_.translation: 여기서 다시 재생하면 이야기가 그 체크포인트로 돌아가요. 갤러리/글로벌 잠금 해제는 그대로 유지돼요.

ui.auto.save_system_is_not_ready_yet.5pb.source: Save system is not ready yet.

ui.auto.select_a_saved_decisive_choice_t.source: Select a saved decisive choice to restore the full checkpoint saved before that replayable conversation began.
ui.auto.select_a_saved_decisive_choice_t.translation: 재생 가능한 대화가 시작되기 전에 저장된 전체 체크포인트를 복원하려면 저장된 결정적인 선택을 선택하세요.

ui.auto.setup_writes_route_locks_active_.source: Setup writes route locks, active-character state, and required previous completion keys before launch.
ui.auto.setup_writes_route_locks_active_.translation: 설정은 시작 전에 루트 잠금, 활성 캐릭터 상태, 필요한 이전 완료 키를 기록합니다.

ui.auto.something_went_wrong_while_loadi.source: Something went wrong while loading the game

ui.auto.sorry_the_rain_ended_things_earl.source: Sorry the rain ended things early. I still liked the walk more than I expected.
ui.auto.sorry_the_rain_ended_things_earl.translation: 비 때문에 일이 일찍 끝났네요. 그래도 예상보다 산책이 더 좋았어요.

ui.auto.spend_all_remaining_points_befor.source: Spend all remaining points before continuing.
ui.auto.spend_all_remaining_points_befor.translation: 계속하기 전에 남은 포인트를 모두 사용하세요.

ui.auto.spend_all_remaining_points_to_co.source: Spend all remaining points to continue.

ui.auto.starting_the_new_update_will_mov.source: Starting the new update will move your current story progress to the new update entry point. Your gallery and settings will be kept. Continue?
ui.auto.starting_the_new_update_will_mov.translation: 새 업데이트를 시작하면 현재 스토리 진행 상황이 새로운 업데이트 진입점으로 이동해요. 갤러리와 설정은 유지됩니다. 계속할까요?

ui.auto.tap_the_highlighted_male_creator.source: Tap the highlighted male creator and subscribe to continue the story.
ui.auto.tap_the_highlighted_male_creator.translation: 강조된 남성 제작자를 탭하고 구독하여 이야기를 계속하세요.

ui.auto.thank_you_for_the_calm_coffee_i_.source: Thank you for the calm coffee. I enjoyed your company.
ui.auto.thank_you_for_the_calm_coffee_i_.translation: 차분한 커피 고마워. 너와 함께 해서 즐거웠어.

ui.auto.the_aquarium_was_even_better_wit.source: The aquarium was even better with you beside me.

ui.auto.this_edits_the_saved_contact_nam.source: This edits the saved contact names used everywhere via
ui.auto.this_edits_the_saved_contact_nam.translation: 이건 어디서나 사용되는 저장된 연락처 이름을 수정해.

ui.auto.this_game_is_intended_for_player.source: This game is intended for players aged 18 and older.
ui.auto.this_game_is_intended_for_player.translation: 이 게임은 18세 이상 플레이어를 위한 거야.

ui.auto.this_will_overwrite_your_current.source: This will overwrite your current progress. Continue?
ui.auto.this_will_overwrite_your_current.translation: 현재 진행 중인 내용을 덮어쓰게 될 거야. 계속할래?

ui.auto.total_cannot_exceed_available_po.translation: 총합은 사용 가능한 포인트를 초과할 수 없어.

ui.auto.unable_to_start_from_this_day_pl.source: Unable to start from this day. Please try again.
ui.auto.unable_to_start_from_this_day_pl.translation: 이날부터 시작할 수 없어. 다시 시도해봐.

ui.auto.unable_to_start_from_this_point..source: Unable to start from this point.

ui.auto.unable_to_start_the_update_from_.source: Unable to start the update from here. Please try again.
ui.auto.unable_to_start_the_update_from_.translation: 여기서 업데이트를 시작할 수 없어. 다시 시도해봐.

ui.auto.unlock_all_3_love_skills_and_no_.source: Unlock all 3 LOVE skills and no other branch skills in one run.
ui.auto.unlock_all_3_love_skills_and_no_.translation: 한 번의 플레이로 모든 3개의 LOVE 스킬을 잠금 해제하고 다른 가지 스킬은 잠금 해제하지 마.

ui.auto.unlock_all_3_ntr_skills_and_no_o.source: Unlock all 3 NTR skills and no other branch skills in one run.
ui.auto.unlock_all_3_ntr_skills_and_no_o.translation: 한 번의 플레이로 모든 3개의 NTR 스킬을 잠금 해제하고 다른 가지 스킬은 잠금 해제하지 마.

ui.auto.unlock_all_3_nts_skills_and_no_o.source: Unlock all 3 NTS skills and no other branch skills in one run.
ui.auto.unlock_all_3_nts_skills_and_no_o.translation: 한 번의 플레이로 모든 3개의 NTS 스킬을 잠금 해제하고 다른 가지 스킬은 잠금 해제하지 마.

ui.auto.unlock_the_first_skill_in_each_h.source: Unlock the first skill in each HAK tree: LOVE, NTR and NTS.
ui.auto.unlock_the_first_skill_in_each_h.translation: HAK의 각 스킬 트리(LOVE, NTR, NTS)에서 첫 스킬을 해제하세요.

ui.auto.use_timeline_replay_from_start_a.source: Use Timeline -> Replay from start at least once.
ui.auto.use_timeline_replay_from_start_a.translation: 타임라인 -> 시작부터 다시 플레이를 최소 한 번 해.

ui.auto.warm_sociable_and_looking_for_an.source: Warm, sociable, and looking for an uncomplicated cinema date.
ui.auto.warm_sociable_and_looking_for_an.translation: 따뜻하고 사교적이며 복잡하지 않은 영화 데이트를 찾고 있어.

ui.auto.you_made_the_afternoon_feel_natu.source: You made the afternoon feel natural.

ui.calendar.future_empty.source: New plans appear here as they come up in your conversations.
ui.calendar.future_empty.translation: 대화에서 새로운 계획이 나오면 여기에 표시됩니다.

ui.calendar.history_empty.source: Your conversations and shared plans will appear here.
ui.calendar.history_empty.translation: 나눈 대화와 함께 세운 계획이 여기에 표시됩니다.

ui.calendar.note.source: A record of your conversations, shared plans and daily activities.
ui.calendar.note.translation: 대화와 함께 나눈 약속, 일상 활동의 기록

ui.calendar.reader.empty.source: No recorded text for this chat.

ui.calendar.reader.note.source: Read your recorded chat. Choices and progress stay as they were.
ui.calendar.reader.note.translation: 기록된 대화를 다시 읽습니다. 선택과 진행 상황은 그대로 유지됩니다.

ui.cardvault.collect_pending_before_code.source: Collect your pending Card Vault reveal before redeeming this reward.
ui.cardvault.collect_pending_before_code.translation: 이 보상을 받기 전에 보류 중인 카드 금고 공개를 수집하세요.

ui.cardvault.collect_pending_first.source: Collect your current reward before redeeming this code.
ui.cardvault.collect_pending_first.translation: 이 코드를 사용하기 전에 현재 보상을 수집하세요.

ui.cardvault.pack.basic.art_alt.source: Basic iNTeRcepted Card Vault booster pack
ui.cardvault.pack.basic.art_alt.translation: 기본 iNTeRcepted 카드 금고 부스터 팩

ui.cardvault.pack.basic.description.source: A regular low-cost pack with three cards.
ui.cardvault.pack.basic.description.translation: 세 장의 카드가 들어있는 일반 저가 팩.

ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.art_alt.source: Legendary iNTeRcepted Card Vault booster pack
ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.art_alt.translation: 전설적인 iNTeRcepted 카드 금고 부스터 팩

ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.description.source: A premium vault pack with at least one Legendary card.
ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.description.translation: 최소한 하나의 전설적인 카드가 포함된 프리미엄 금고 팩.

ui.cardvault.pack.premium.art_alt.source: Premium iNTeRcepted Card Vault booster pack
ui.cardvault.pack.premium.art_alt.translation: 프리미엄 iNTeRcepted 카드 금고 부스터 팩

ui.cardvault.pack.premium.description.source: Improved odds for Rare, Epic, and Legendary cards.
ui.cardvault.pack.premium.description.translation: 희귀, 에픽, 전설적인 카드에 대한 확률 향상.

ui.cardvault.special_bonus_hint.source: Enter your private Card Vault bonus code.
ui.cardvault.special_bonus_hint.translation: 비공개 Card Vault 보너스 코드를 입력하세요.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.permanent.source: Every new card is permanently added to your Collection. Character filters adapt to every available character.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.permanent.translation: 모든 새로운 카드는 너의 컬렉션에 영구적으로 추가돼. 캐릭터 필터는 사용 가능한 모든 캐릭터에 맞춰 조정돼.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.rarity.source: Cards have different rarities, and rarer cards are harder to obtain.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.rarity.translation: 카드는 다양한 희귀도를 가지고 있고, 희귀한 카드는 얻기 더 어려워.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.body.source: Enter the code associated with your supporter tier to claim its exact-once Card Vault reward. Promotional reward codes are supported when available.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.body.translation: 너의 후원자 티어와 관련된 코드를 입력해서 한 번만 받을 수 있는 카드 금고 보상을 받아가. 프로모션 보상 코드는 사용 가능할 때 지원돼.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.security.source: Claimed codes cannot grant their reward again. Private QA and developer codes are never shown here.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.security.translation: 한 번 사용한 코드는 다시 보상을 줄 수 없어. 개인 QA와 개발자 코드는 여기서 절대 보여지지 않아.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.body.source: Every card you unlock is stored here. Browse discovered cards and identify cards that are still locked.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.body.translation: 너가 잠금 해제한 모든 카드는 여기 저장돼. 발견한 카드를 둘러보고 아직 잠금 상태인 카드를 확인해.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.filters.source: Filters automatically include all current and future Card Vault characters.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.filters.translation: 필터는 현재와 미래의 모든 카드 금고 캐릭터를 자동으로 포함해.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.dust.body.source: A card you already own becomes Card Dust. Dust records the value of your duplicates and is preserved for future use.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.dust.body.translation: 이미 가지고 있는 카드는 카드 먼지가 돼. 먼지는 너의 중복 카드 가치를 기록하고 미래에 사용할 수 있도록 보존돼.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.body.source: To get you started, your first Basic Pack is on us.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.body.translation: 시작할 수 있도록 너의 첫 번째 기본 팩은 우리가 제공할게.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.discover.source: Open it and discover your first {count} cards.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.discover.translation: Open it and discover your first 3 cards.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.points.body.source: Card Points open Card Vault packs. Rewards, supporter benefits, and special Card Vault codes can grant them. Card Points and Card Dust are separate currencies.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.points.body.translation: 카드 포인트로 카드 금고 팩을 열 수 있어. 보상, 후원자 혜택, 특별 카드 금고 코드로 얻을 수 있어. 카드 포인트와 카드 먼지는 별도의 통화야.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.noncanon.source: Remember: Card Vault is bonus content, and its cards are not canon to the official iNTeRcepted story.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.noncanon.translation: 기억해: 카드 금고는 보너스 콘텐츠이고, 그 카드들은 공식 iNTeRcepted 이야기와는 관련이 없어.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.summary.source: Open packs, discover cards, complete your Collection, convert duplicates into Card Dust, spend Card Points, and claim supporter rewards in Codes.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.summary.translation: 팩을 열고, 카드를 발견하고, 컬렉션을 완성하고, 중복 카드를 카드 먼지로 변환하고, 카드 포인트를 사용하고, 코드에서 후원자 보상을 받아가.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.body.source: After all cards are revealed, select any card to inspect it fullscreen. Close the viewer to return to the complete pack result.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.body.translation: 모든 카드가 공개된 후, 어떤 카드를 선택해 전체 화면으로 확인해. 뷰어를 닫으면 전체 팩 결과로 돌아갈 수 있어.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.controls.source: Use touch or mouse, the visible close button, the area outside the card, or Escape on desktop.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.controls.translation: 터치나 마우스를 사용하거나, 보이는 닫기 버튼, 카드 외부 영역, 또는 데스크탑에서 Escape 키를 사용해.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.bonus.source: Card Vault is a bonus collectible system where you can unlock exclusive cards featuring characters from iNTeRcepted.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.bonus.translation: 카드 금고는 iNTeRcepted의 캐릭터가 포함된 독점 카드를 잠금 해제할 수 있는 보너스 수집 시스템이야.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.independen.source: Opening packs, collecting cards, and spending Card Points never affect story progress, choices, relationships, or routes.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.independen.translation: 팩을 열고, 카드를 수집하고, 카드 포인트를 사용하는 것은 이야기 진행, 선택, 관계, 또는 경로에 영향을 주지 않아.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.noncanon.source: These cards are not canon. Their scenes do not necessarily happen in the official story and are bonus collectible artwork.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.noncanon.translation: 이 카드는 정통성이 없어. 이 장면들은 공식 이야기에서 반드시 일어나는 것이 아니며 보너스 수집 아트워크야.

ui.conversation.auto_fast.source: Auto Play: fast (green). Pauses for choices. Select to turn off.
ui.conversation.auto_fast.translation: 자동 재생: 빠르게(초록색). 선택지가 나오면 멈춥니다. 선택하면 끕니다.

ui.conversation.auto_normal.source: Auto Play: normal (yellow). Pauses for choices. Select for fast playback.
ui.conversation.auto_normal.translation: 자동 재생: 보통(노란색). 선택지가 나오면 멈춥니다. 선택하면 빠르게 재생합니다.

ui.conversation.auto_off.source: Auto Play off. Tap to read. Select to enable automatic playback.
ui.conversation.auto_off.translation: 자동 재생이 꺼져 있습니다. 탭해서 읽으세요. 선택하면 자동 재생을 켭니다.

ui.conversation.preview.sent_attachment.translation: 죄송하지만, 첨부파일을 확인할 수 없습니다. 내용을 제공해 주시면 번역해 드리겠습니다.

ui.conversation.preview.sent_audio.translation: 죄송하지만, "Audio"라는 단어만으로는 번역할 내용이 없습니다. 더 많은 정보를 제공해 주시면 도와드리겠습니다!

ui.dev_support.all_overlord.source: All NTR Overlord benefits, including early test builds
ui.dev_support.all_overlord.translation: 테스트 빌드 미리 플레이를 포함한 NTR Overlord의 모든 혜택

ui.dev_support.dev_updates.translation: 개발 소식 및 진행 상황 안내

ui.dev_support.discord_full.source: Full Discord access and community discussions
ui.dev_support.discord_full.translation: Discord 전체 이용 및 커뮤니티 토론 참여

ui.dev_support.intro.source: Your support gives me more time to create new conversations, scenes and choices for iNTeRcepted. Choose the tier that suits you and enjoy the rewards below. Thank you for being part of the story!
ui.dev_support.intro.translation: 여러분의 후원 덕분에 iNTeRcepted의 새로운 대화, 장면, 선택지를 만드는 데 더 많은 시간을 쓸 수 있습니다. 자신에게 맞는 등급을 선택하고 아래 혜택을 누려 보세요. 이 이야기와 함께해 주셔서 감사합니다!

ui.dev_support.patreon.source: Support the game on Patreon and choose your rewards
ui.dev_support.patreon.translation: Patreon에서 게임을 후원하고 원하는 혜택을 선택하세요

ui.dev_support.points_note.source: Enter your supporter code in Settings, then claim your bonus points in Card Vault to open more packs. Your tier also unlocks any unclaimed lower-tier bonuses. Each bonus can be claimed once.
ui.dev_support.points_note.translation: 설정에서 후원자 코드를 입력한 뒤 Card Vault에서 보너스 포인트를 받으면 더 많은 팩을 열 수 있습니다. 가입한 등급보다 낮은 등급의 보너스 중 아직 받지 않은 보너스도 받을 수 있습니다. 각 보너스는 한 번만 받을 수 있습니다.

ui.dev_support.previews.translation: 공개 예정 콘텐츠 독점 미리 보기

ui.dev_support.story_votes.translation: 일부 스토리 요소에 대한 투표 참여

ui.dev_support.subscribestar.source: Prefer SubscribeStar? The same tier benefits are available here.
ui.dev_support.subscribestar.translation: SubscribeStar를 선호하시나요? 이곳에서도 등급별로 동일한 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

ui.dev_support.test_builds.source: Play test builds and unfinished versions earlier, while the next update is still in development
ui.dev_support.test_builds.translation: 다음 업데이트가 아직 개발 중일 때 테스트 빌드와 미완성 버전을 먼저 플레이

ui.dev_support.title.source: Help bring the next chapter to life
ui.dev_support.title.translation: 다음 챕터를 완성할 수 있도록 힘을 보태 주세요

ui.gallery.empty.source: No photos yet. They will appear here automatically.
ui.gallery.empty.translation: 아직 사진이 없어. 여기 자동으로 나타날 거야.

ui.gallery.hints.complete.source: All photos in this filter are discovered.

ui.gallery.hints.continue.source: Continue this character's story and check their received posts.
ui.gallery.hints.continue.translation: 이 캐릭터의 이야기를 진행하고 받은 게시물을 확인하세요.

ui.gallery.hints.evidence.source: Unlock the corresponding HAK Evidence skill and open the received evidence.
ui.gallery.hints.evidence.translation: 해당 HAK 증거 스킬을 해제하고 받은 증거를 여세요.

ui.gallery.hints.intro.source: Hints show days, routes and choices for missing photos. Photos stay hidden until you discover them.
ui.gallery.hints.intro.translation: 힌트는 미발견 사진과 관련된 날짜, 루트, 선택지를 보여줍니다. 사진은 발견할 때까지 숨겨집니다.

ui.gallery.hints.receive_photos.source: Choose to know and receive the shared photos (option 1).
ui.gallery.hints.receive_photos.translation: 상황을 알고 공유된 사진도 받는 선택지를 선택하세요(선택지 1).

ui.gallery.hints.subscription.source: Subscribe to this OnlyFun account to view its received post.
ui.gallery.hints.subscription.translation: 이 OnlyFun 계정을 구독하면 받은 게시물을 볼 수 있습니다.

ui.gallery.route.note.source: Route filters also include shared photos.

ui.gallery.sort.discovery_note.source: Photos without a recorded discovery date appear last, in photo number order.
ui.gallery.sort.discovery_note.translation: 발견 날짜가 기록되지 않은 사진은 번호순으로 맨 뒤에 표시됩니다.

ui.hak.first_points_thought.source: So my choices earned HAK points. I should check the skill tree and see what I can unlock.
ui.hak.first_points_thought.translation: 내 선택으로 HAK 포인트를 얻었구나. 스킬 트리에서 무엇을 해금할 수 있는지 확인해 봐야겠어.

ui.hak.first_skill_spend_thought_love.source: I want to understand them better and be there for them.
ui.hak.first_skill_spend_thought_love.translation: 그들을 더 잘 이해하고 곁에서 힘이 되어 주고 싶어.

ui.hak.first_skill_spend_thought_ntr.source: Part of me wants to know more, even if I may not like what I find.
ui.hak.first_skill_spend_thought_ntr.translation: 알게 된 사실이 마음에 들지 않을 수도 있지만, 더 알고 싶은 마음도 있어.

ui.hak.first_skill_spend_thought_nts.source: I don't know why, but this turns me on.

ui.hak.notice_text.source: Unchecked targets will be excluded from progression. You will no longer receive messages or story events from them.
ui.hak.notice_text.translation: 체크하지 않은 대상은 진행에서 제외됩니다. 더 이상 그들로부터 메시지나 스토리 이벤트를 받지 않게 됩니다.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_audio_tr.source: Reading their words might help me understand what they can't say to me.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_audio_tr.translation: 그 사람들이 한 말을 읽으면 내게 차마 하지 못하는 말도 이해할 수 있을지도 몰라.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_evidence.source: Maybe these moments will help me understand what they need.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_evidence.translation: 이 순간들을 보면 그 사람들에게 무엇이 필요한지 이해할 수 있을지도 몰라.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_risk_war.source: I want to understand them better and be there for them.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_risk_war.translation: 그들을 더 잘 이해하고 곁에서 힘이 되어 주고 싶어.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_route_re.source: I can see a way to show them I care.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_love_route_re.translation: 내가 얼마나 아끼는지 보여 줄 방법이 보이네.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_audio_tra.source: Now I can read their words for myself. What haven't they told me?
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_audio_tra.translation: 이제 그 사람들이 한 말을 직접 읽을 수 있어. 내게 말하지 않은 게 뭘까?

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_evidence_.source: HAK kept a record. I need to see what I've been missing.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_evidence_.translation: HAK가 기록을 남겨 뒀네. 내가 놓친 게 뭔지 확인해야겠어.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_passive_i.source: Part of me wants to know more, even if I may not like what I find.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_passive_i.translation: 알게 된 사실이 마음에 들지 않을 수도 있지만, 더 알고 싶은 마음도 있어.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_route_rev.source: I can see which choice will bring me closer to the truth, even if it hurts.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_ntr_route_rev.translation: 어떤 선택이 진실에 가까워지는 길인지 알 것 같아. 아프더라도.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_audio_tra.source: Reading their conversations might tell me when to make my move.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_audio_tra.translation: 대화를 읽어 보면 언제 나서야 할지 알 수 있을지도 몰라.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_evidence_.source: There might be an opportunity in what HAK has recorded.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_evidence_.translation: HAK가 남긴 기록 속에 기회가 있을지도 몰라.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_opportuni.source: I don't know why, but this turns me on.

ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_route_rev.source: Now I can see the opening. I just have to take it.
ui.hak.skill_spend_thought_nts_route_rev.translation: 이제 기회가 보여. 잡기만 하면 돼.

ui.hak.skill_tree_description.source: Spend NTS, NTR, and LOVE points to unlock skills that reveal new information and guide your choices. Skills never block core story events.
ui.hak.skill_tree_description.translation: NTS, NTR, LOVE 포인트를 사용해 새로운 정보를 밝혀 주고 선택에 도움을 주는 스킬을 해제하세요. 스킬은 주요 스토리 이벤트를 막지 않습니다.

ui.home.hak_os.translation: 죄송하지만, "HAK//OS"에 대한 번역을 제공할 수 없습니다. 추가적인 정보나 다른 요청이 있으시면 말씀해 주세요!

ui.meetandgreet.install_to_unlock.source: Install MeetAndGreet through the story to unlock this feed.
ui.meetandgreet.install_to_unlock.translation: 이 피드를 잠금 해제하려면 스토리를 통해 MeetAndGreet를 설치해야 해.

ui.meetandgreet.no_profiles.source: No profiles unlocked yet. Evelyn will discover them through the story.
ui.meetandgreet.no_profiles.translation: 아직 잠금 해제된 프로필이 없어. 에블린이 스토리를 통해 발견할 거야.

ui.meetandgreet.photos_empty.source: Date photos will appear here after Evelyn meets someone.
ui.meetandgreet.photos_empty.translation: 에블린이 누군가를 만나면 여기 데이트 사진이 나타날 거야.

ui.new_update.entry_owner.source: The update entry must belong to a selected character
ui.new_update.entry_owner.translation: 업데이트 시작 장면은 선택한 캐릭터의 장면이어야 합니다

ui.new_update.lena_code_prompt.source: Enter the Lena update code to unlock Day 16 onward.
ui.new_update.lena_code_prompt.translation: Lena 업데이트 코드를 입력하면 16일 차 이후의 콘텐츠가 잠금 해제됩니다.

ui.new_update.lena_code_required.source: This update requires the Lena code

ui.new_update.no_code.source: I do not have a code

ui.new_update.route_owner.source: Update routes must belong to selected characters

ui.new_update.route_unavailable.source: This route is not available in the update
ui.new_update.route_unavailable.translation: 이 루트는 업데이트에서 이용할 수 없습니다

ui.onlyfun.creator_empty.source: This creator has not posted anything yet.
ui.onlyfun.creator_empty.translation: 이 크리에이터는 아직 아무것도 올리지 않았어.

ui.onlyfun.evelyn_photo_thought_d7.source: Another photo of {{name:evelyn}}... What is happening at that bar that she hasn't told me?
ui.onlyfun.evelyn_photo_thought_d7.translation: 또 {{name:evelyn}} 사진이네... 그 바에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거지? 나한테 말하지 않은 게 있나?

ui.onlyfun.evelyn_photo_thought_d8.source: That's {{name:evelyn}} again... I told her to keep working there, but I still don't know the whole story.
ui.onlyfun.evelyn_photo_thought_d8.translation: 또 {{name:evelyn}}이네... 거기서 계속 일하라고 한 건 나지만, 아직 모든 사정을 아는 건 아니야.

ui.onlyfun.install_from_messages.source: Install and unlock the app from messages first.
ui.onlyfun.install_from_messages.translation: 먼저 메시지에서 앱을 설치하고 잠금을 해제해.

ui.onlyfun.locked_post.source: Locked post. Subscribe to reveal this content.
ui.onlyfun.locked_post.translation: 잠금 해제된 게시물. 이 콘텐츠를 보려면 구독하세요.

ui.onlyfun.login_copy.source: OnlyFun needs a quick connect before you can browse creators.
ui.onlyfun.login_copy.translation: OnlyFun을 이용하려면 크리에이터를 탐색하기 전에 빠른 연결이 필요해.

ui.onlyfun.subscribed_empty.source: Subscribed creators have not posted anything yet.
ui.onlyfun.subscribed_empty.translation: 구독한 제작자들이 아직 아무것도 올리지 않았어요.

ui.onlyfun.tap_creator_to_view.source: Tap a creator bubble and subscribe to view posts.
ui.onlyfun.tap_creator_to_view.translation: 제작자 버블을 탭하고 구독하여 게시물을 보세요.

ui.onlyfun.tap_required_creator.source: Tap the highlighted male creator and subscribe to continue.
ui.onlyfun.tap_required_creator.translation: 강조된 남성 제작자를 탭하고 구독하여 계속하세요.

ui.onlyfun.unlock_before_browsing.source: Unlock the app before browsing creator content.
ui.onlyfun.unlock_before_browsing.translation: 크리에이터 콘텐츠를 탐색하기 전에 앱을 잠금 해제해.

ui.player.name_setup_description.source: Choose your name, or confirm Theo to keep the default. You can change it later in Settings.
ui.player.name_setup_description.translation: 이름을 입력하거나 기본 이름인 Theo를 확인해 줘. 나중에 설정에서 바꿀 수 있어.

ui.player.name_setup_error.source: Your name could not be saved. Please try again.
ui.player.name_setup_error.translation: 이름을 저장하지 못했어. 다시 시도해 줘.

ui.player.nametag_description.source: This name appears on your OnlyFun and Snapgram comments. You can change it anytime.
ui.player.nametag_description.translation: 이 이름은 OnlyFun과 Snapgram에 남긴 댓글에 표시됩니다. 언제든지 변경할 수 있어요.

ui.player.nametag_error.source: Your nametag could not be saved. Please try again.
ui.player.nametag_error.translation: 사용자 이름을 저장하지 못했어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.

ui.save.manual.translation: 죄송하지만, "MANUAL"이라는 단어는 번역할 수 없습니다. 다른 내용을 제공해 주시면 도와드리겠습니다!

ui.settings.confirm_reset_text.source: Are you sure you want to reset?

ui.settings.no_contacts.source: No renamed contacts yet. Contacts will appear here after you name them in a conversation.
ui.settings.no_contacts.translation: 아직 이름이 바뀐 연락처가 없어요. 대화에서 이름을 정하면 여기 나타날 거예요.

ui.settings.rechoose_hak_confirm.source: This will clear HAK character selection and IF branch cache only. Continue?
ui.settings.rechoose_hak_confirm.translation: 이건 HAK 캐릭터 선택과 IF 분기 캐시만 지울 거야. 계속할래?

ui.settings.reset_all_confirm.source: This will wipe everything (including the gallery). Continue?
ui.settings.reset_all_confirm.translation: 이 모든 게 지워져요 (갤러리 포함). 계속할래요?

ui.settings.reset_keep_gallery_confirm.source: This will clear story, messages and settings, but keep the gallery. Continue?
ui.settings.reset_keep_gallery_confirm.translation: 이렇게 하면 스토리, 메시지, 설정이 초기화되지만 갤러리는 유지돼요. 계속할까요?

ui.settings.return_home_after_chat.source: Return to home after each chat
ui.settings.return_home_after_chat.translation: 대화가 끝날 때마다 홈 화면으로 돌아가기

ui.settings.return_home_after_chat_hint.source: Return to the phone home screen when a conversation ends.
ui.settings.return_home_after_chat_hint.translation: 대화가 끝나면 휴대전화 홈 화면으로 돌아갑니다.

ui.social.comment_length.source: Write a comment of 1 to 500 characters.

ui.social.unavailable.source: This post is no longer available. Reopen the app to refresh it.
ui.social.unavailable.translation: 이 게시물은 더 이상 볼 수 없습니다. 앱을 다시 열어 새로고침하세요.

ui.storage.full.card_vault.source: Storage is full. The pack was not opened and no points were spent.
ui.storage.full.card_vault.translation: 저장 공간이 가득 찼어요. 팩이 열리지 않았고 포인트도 사용되지 않았어요.

ui.storage.full.card_vault_reward.source: Storage is full. The reward was not claimed.
ui.storage.full.card_vault_reward.translation: 저장 공간이 가득 찼어요. 보상을 받지 못했어요.

ui.storage.full.load.source: This save could not be loaded because the internal save space of the game is full. Your saves are not damaged. Close and reopen the game so it can compact its data, then try again. If this message comes back, install the latest version of the game.
ui.storage.full.load.translation: 게임 내부 저장 공간이 가득 차서 이 저장 파일을 불러올 수 없습니다. 저장 파일은 손상되지 않았습니다. 게임을 닫았다가 다시 열어 데이터를 압축한 뒤 다시 시도하세요. 이 메시지가 다시 나타나면 최신 버전의 게임을 설치하세요.

ui.storage.full.progress.source: The internal save space of the game is full. This is storage reserved for the game inside the app, not the storage of your phone. Your progress so far is safe and this step was not lost. Close and reopen the game so it can compact its data, then continue. If this message comes back, install the latest version of the game.
ui.storage.full.progress.translation: 게임 내부 저장 공간이 가득 찼습니다. 이는 앱 안에서 게임용으로 예약된 공간이며, 휴대폰의 저장 공간이 아닙니다. 지금까지의 진행 상황은 안전하며 이 단계도 사라지지 않았습니다. 게임을 닫았다가 다시 열어 데이터를 압축한 뒤 계속하세요. 이 메시지가 다시 나타나면 최신 버전의 게임을 설치하세요.

ui.storage.full.save_device.source: There is not enough free space on this device to create this save. Your current game is still safe and playable. Free some space on your phone, then try again.
ui.storage.full.save_device.translation: 이 기기에 저장 파일을 만들 여유 공간이 부족합니다. 현재 게임은 여전히 안전하게 플레이할 수 있습니다. 휴대폰의 공간을 확보한 뒤 다시 시도하세요.

ui.storage.full.save_internal.source: The internal save space of the game is full, so this save was not created. Your current game is still safe and playable. This is storage reserved for the game, not the storage of your phone.
ui.storage.full.save_internal.translation: 게임 내부 저장 공간이 가득 차서 이 저장 파일을 만들지 못했습니다. 현재 게임은 여전히 안전하게 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이는 게임용으로 예약된 공간이며, 휴대폰의 저장 공간이 아닙니다.

ui.story.chapters_copy.source: Global chapter checkpoints remain separate from character route browsing.
ui.story.chapters_copy.translation: 글로벌 챕터 체크포인트는 캐릭터 루트 탐색과 별개로 유지됩니다.

ui.story.character_routes_copy.source: Choose a character to enter a dedicated route browser with route state, progress, and replayable story nodes.
ui.story.character_routes_copy.translation: 캐릭터를 선택하면 전용 경로 브라우저에 들어가서 경로 상태, 진행 상황, 재생 가능한 스토리 노드를 확인할 수 있어요.

ui.story.restart.confirm.source: Restart the story from the beginning? Your saves, unlocked gallery images, Card Vault collection, achievements, access codes, names and settings will be kept.
ui.story.restart.confirm.translation: 이야기를 처음부터 다시 시작할까요? 저장 파일, 잠금 해제한 갤러리 이미지, Card Vault 컬렉션, 업적, 액세스 코드, 이름, 설정은 유지됩니다.

ui.story.restart.failed.source: The story could not be restarted. Your current progress has been kept. Please try again.
ui.story.restart.failed.translation: 이야기를 다시 시작할 수 없습니다. 현재 진행 상황은 유지되었습니다. 다시 시도해 주세요.

ui.thanks.abyssal_message.source: A huge thank you to AbyssalEros for your incredible generosity and support. You help bring iNTeRcepted to life.
